tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /bod yul bstan pa'i mnga' bdag rje btsun sa skya pa'i yab chos lam skor phyi ma brgyad kyi khrid yig sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po'i gsung rtsom 'phro can gyi kha bskang pa don gnyis lhun grub phrin las rgyun mi chad pa'i dga' ston zhes bya ba bzhugs/ /bkra shis// na mo gu ru a nan+da pu n+yā ye/ bka' drin mnyam med rtsa ba'i bla ma mchog /'jam pa'i dbyangs nyid ngur smrig 'dzin pa'i gtso/ /kun dga' bsod nams zhabs pad dam pa la/ /snying nas thal sbyar spyi bos phyag bgyi'o/ /shākya ye shes las brgyud sa skya pa/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug kun dga' snying po sogs/ /rje btsun yab sras brgyud pa'i bla ma la/ /gus pa'i yid kyis rab tu phyag 'tshal lo/ /in+d+ra bhū ti klu sgrub tog rtse pa/ /ngag gi dbang phyug ḍom+bhi mtsho skyes zhabs/ /nag po spyod dang nag po u tsi ṭa/ /grub chen brgyad la spyi bos phyag 'tshal lo/ /yongs 'dzin dam pa dkon mchog lhun grub dang / /sbas pa'i rnal 'byor dpal ldan bkra shis pa/ /bka' drin che ba'i bla ma yi dam la/ /sgo gsum dang ba'i yid kyis phyag 'tshal lo/ /de ltar bstod cing gsol ba legs btab nas/ /rje btsun 'brog mi lo tsā chen po nas/ /nye bar brgyud pa'i snyan brgyud zab mo las/ /lam skor phyi ma'i khrid yig bshad kyi nyon/ /de la 'dir lam skor phyi ma brgyad kyi khrid kyi tshe/ rang la lam 'bras yongs rdzogs thob pa'i slob ma yin na dbang gzhan ma grub kyang 'di dag gi khrid byar rung tsam yin la/ de ltar ma yin na lhan cig skyes grub la kyai rdor 'grel ba lugs kyi dbang / pad ma'i lam la mtsho skyes lugs kyi dbang / bsam mi khyab la bdag med ma'i dbang / gtum mo lam rdzogs la bde mchog nag po pa'i dbang rnams dgos zhes rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po'i gsung bgros dngos slob rnams kyis yi ger bkod pa las byung bas de dag thams cad dam/

ma mtha' yang rang la kyai rdor man ngag lugs sam/ bdag med ma'am/ kyai rdor 'grel ba lugs sam/ kyai rdor mtsho skyes lugs te/ rje 'brog mi nas sa skya pa yab sras la brgyud de lam skor gyi brgyud pa 'di pa las byon pa'i dbang gang yang rung ba tshad ldan zhig thob pa'i slob ma la bya dgos te/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor dang bskyed rdzogs kyi skabs thams cad du khrid kyi rnal 'byor bsgom pa thams cad la dbang thob pa'i bla ma zhig dgos par rje btsun sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta chen pos dgag sgrub rgya chen po'i sgo nas yang yang gsungs shing brgyud pa 'di pas phyag len la khel bar mdzad pa'i phyir ro/ /de lta bu'i slob ma mang nyung ji ltar rigs pa la/ yig brgya dang chos gtor maṇ+ḍal rnams sngon du btang nas/ 'o sems can thams cad kyi don du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang chen po'i go 'phang 'thob par bya/ de'i ched du gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i bskyed rdzogs kyi chos zab mo gsan la don tshul bzhin du nyams su blang snyam pa byang chub kyi mchog tu thugs bskyed pa gsal btab nas gsan pa dang / chos gsan pa'i kun tu spyod pa rnams rdo rje theg pa'i gzhung lugs las ji ltar 'byung ba ltar gsal btab nas gsan par zhu/ de la 'o skol gyi ston pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis gdul bya rnams kyi don du chos kyi phung po bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig gsungs pa rnams kyi nang nas mchog tu gyur pa rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud rnams yin/ de dag la brten nas rdo rje bdag med ma la sogs pa'i yi dam gyi lha'i gsung bzhin du 'phags yul gyi grub pa'i slob dpon rnams kyis lam srol mi 'dra ba du ma zhig bkral ba las/ zab cing khungs thub pa lam skor dgu zhes grags la/ de dag slob dpon dpa' bo rdo rje dang / paṇ+ḍi ta ga ya dha ra dang / u rgyan gyi paṇ+ḍi ta shes rab gsang ba dang /

grub chen a mo gha badz+ra rnams la/ rtsod pa'i dus kyi rdo rje 'chang chen po 'brog mi lo tsā ba shākya ye shes kyis gsan nas bshad sgrub mdzad pa'i rgyun rje btsun sa skya pa chen po kun dga' snying po la bka' bab cing / de nyid kyis thugs nyams su bzhes nas thugs dam gyi snying por mdzad pas mkhas pa dang grub pa'i go 'phang mngon du mdzad nas dar rgyas su mdzad pa las/ sras kyi thu bo rje btsun sku mched nas bzung ste rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bar du byon pa'i dpal ldan sa skya pa'i zab chos zab mo lam skor dgu zhes nyi zla ltar grags pa'i nang nas lam 'dir lam skor phyi ma brgyad kyi khrid rnams 'chad par bya ba la smin par bya ba'i dbang dang / grol bar byed pa'i lam gnyis las/ dang po smin byed kyi dbang ni brgyud pa 'di dag las 'ongs pa'i dbang bzhi tshad dang ldan pa zhig lam skor gyi khrid zhu yul gyi bla ma de nyid la/ khrid zhu ba po'i slob ma rnams kyis thob pa zhig nges par dgos pa sngon du grub zin nas/ gnyis pa grol bar byed pa'i lam la sngon 'gro dang dngos gzhi gnyis yod pa las sngon 'gro la khrid kha yar ba re re byed pa'i tshe sngon 'gro rnams kyang so sor bya dgos pa yin na'ang / 'dir khrid brgyad po dkyus gcig la gtong ba'i tshe/ sngon 'gro rnams thun mong du thog mar bya ba 'di kas chog pa yin pas/ de la tshogs gsog par byed pa maṇ+ḍal gyi rnal 'byor/ sdig pa sbyong bar byed pa rdo rje sems dpa'i sgom bzlas/ byin rlabs 'jug par byed pa bla ma'i rnal 'byor dang gsum las zhes sogs rgyud gsum mdzes rgyan nas 'byung bzhin nub gsum mam gnyis sam/ gcig la bya ba long skabs dang / slob ma'i blo tshod dang bstun la bya/ de ltar sngon 'gro'i rim pa rnams sngon du song nas/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi la slob dpon tog rtse pas bkral ba'i bsam mi khyab kyi khrid 'di'i byin rlabs paṇa chen gung ru sogs kyis mdzad pa'i yig cha'i steng nas mdzad/

la rgyu dus na lta ba gtan la dbab pa/ lam dus na ting nge 'dzin bskyed cing sbyang ba/ 'bras dus na ye shes mngon du gyur pa ste gsum las/ dang po rgyu dus na lta ba gtan la dbab pa la/ gdam ngag gi rten bca' ba lus ngag yid gsum/ de shes par byed pa'i dus gsum/ de 'jal bar byed pa'i bsam pa gsum/ gtan la 'bebs par byed pa'i tshad ma gsum ste gdam ngag gi gzhi 'god pa bcu gnyis kyi sgo nas gtan la dbab dgos te rje btsun rin po che'i khrid yig las 'byung ba ltar spros pa gcod yig rnying nang bzhin blo nas 'thon pa'am/ yang na de thad kyi go don rnams dpe thog nas bklags la ngo sprod/ pa yin/ dmigs par dril nas nyams su blang rgyu med/ gnyis pa lam dus na ting nge 'dzin bskyed cing sbyang ba la bdun te thog mar sems gzung / bar du de kho na nyid la blo bzhag spyod lam thams cad du goms par bya/ bsam gtan gyi gegs bying ba dang rgod pa bsal/ bogs 'byin rnam pa brgyad kyis bogs dbyung / sems nyams kyi drod rtags dang sbyar/ mthar spyod pas 'bras bu dang mtshams sbyar ba'o/ /dang po sems gzung ba la gsum sbyor ba/ dngos gzhi/ rjes so/ /dang po la gnad la dbab pa gsum dang sgom pa gsum sngon du 'gro dgos pas/ dang po gnad la dbab pa gsum gyi dang po lus gnad la dbab pa ni/ rkang pa rdo rje'i skyil krung / lag pa mnyam gzhag sgal tshigs bsrang / mgrin pa cung zad dgug mig sna rtser phab/ lce rkan la sbyar/ so dang mchu cung zad ma reg par bya/ dbugs dal gyis rgyur gzhug ro stod dgye bar bya'o/ /ngag gnad la dbab pa ni yid la ci yang mi bsam par sna sgo nas rlung drag tu lan gsum phyir 'bud/ sems gnad la dbab pa ni shes pa khong lhod glod nas gzo med lhug par dar cig 'jog go /gnyis pa sgom pa gsum la byang chub kyi sems sgom pa/ bla ma spyi bor sgom pa/ rang yi dam gyi lhar sgom pa'o/

/dang po ni dben pa'i gnas su bsam gtan gyi spyod lam dang ldan pas mdun gyi nam mkhar skyabs yul rnams gsal btab ste/ de dag gi mdun du rang dang sems can thams cad 'khod nas skyabs 'gro byed par bsam la/ ngag tu bdag dang 'gro ba zhes sogs sgrub thabs kyi dbu nas 'byung ba'i skyabs 'gro nyer gcig sogs bya/ bla ma dang dkon mchog rin po che sogs kyis gsol ba btab pas skyabs yul rnams rang la thim par bsam/ de nas sems bskyed pa'i sngon du snying rje bsgom par bya ste zhes sogs rgyud gsum mdzes rgyan gyi bsag sbyang gi skabs ltar sems bskyed bya tshul bshad/ gnyis pa bla ma spyi bor sgom pa ni rang gi spyi bor seṅge chen po brgyad kyis btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bdag gi rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pa dus gsum gyi rgyal ba sras dang slob mar bcas pa thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bo rnam pa rigs thams cad kyi khyab bdag drug pa rdo rje 'chang chen po zhes sogs nas/ rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ de'i thugs ka nas 'od zer pho nya lta bu 'phros pas zhes pa nas brtsams te/ yang yang du bskyed la ngag tu gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid ces pa'i sh+lau ka dang po yang nas yang du brjod cing / snying gi dkyil zhes pa nas/ 'od zer 'ja' tshon lta bu'i rnam par zhu ste rang gi spyi bo nas thim pas bla ma'i byin rlabs zhugs par bsam mo/ /gsum pa rang yi dam gyi lhar bsgom pa ni hūm̐ zhes brjod pas gnas khang bsrung ba'i 'khor lo/ hūm̐ zhes brjod pas de'i nang du gzhal yas khang / hūm̐ zhes brjod pas de'i dbus su pad+ma nyi ma mi ro mgo g.yon phyogs su bstan pa'i steng du bdag nyid rdo rje bdag med ma sku mdog sngon mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma g.yas rdo rje gri gug 'phyar zhing / g.yon thod khrag thugs kar 'dzin pa/

gru mo g.yon par kha ṭ+wam̐ ga 'dzin pa/ rus pa'i rgyan cha lngas brgyan cing stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ zhabs g.yon brkyangs pa'i skyil krung phyed pa'i gar stabs kyis ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i sku snang la rang bzhin med pa me long nang gi gzugs brnyan lta bu zhig wal gyis gsal gdab/ de'i spyi bor sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku rdo rje'i rang bzhin oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gsung rdo rje'i rang bzhin āḥdamar po/ thugs kar sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs rdo rje'i ngo bo hūm̐ sngon po rnams rang chas su bsgoms ste/ de rnams dang rang gi lus ngag yid ye shes ngo bo dbyer med yin zhes dran par byas la oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes lan gsum brjod do/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi la thung ngur bslab pa dang / ring por bslab pa gnyis/ dang po la rang gi sna rtse nas yid kyis bcal ba'i sor bzhi tshun chad kyi nam mkha' la rang gi shes pa yod par dmigs te lus sems gnyis ka grims par byas la sgom pa ni tshar bcad pa'i tshul du bslab pa'o/ /de nas lus sems gnyis ka glod nas bsgom ste phan 'dogs pa'i tshul du bslab pa'o/ /yang sor brgyad tshun gyi nam mkha' la tshul de nyid kyis bslab/ yang sor bcu drug nas 'dom gang tshun chad kyi nam mkha' la tshul de nyid kyis bslab bo/ /gnyis pa de la bogs dbyung ba'i phyir ring du bslab pa ni rang rig pa'i sems de shar phyogs su 'dom do la sogs pa nas bzung ste ji srid nam mkha'i mthar thug gi bar du rtag tu btang / de bzhin du lho la sogs pa'i phyogs bzhi dang mtshams bzhi la'ang 'dom do la sogs pa nas ji srid nam mkha'i mthar thug gi bar du rtag tu btang / steng du rgod pa dang 'og du bying bas mi bya gsungs/ de'ang tshar bcad pa'i tshul dang phan gdags pa'i tshul du bslabs te nam mkha' dang rang sems bsres la mnyam par bzhag

de ltar bsgoms pas nam mkha' ltar sems stong pa mtha' thams cad bral ba'i nyams skye ba ni mtha' bral gyi nyams/ sems shugs chad de lhan ne gnas pa ni shugs chad kyi nyams/ phyi'i rgya mtsho'i gzings nas spur ba'i phug ron slar gzings su 'khor ba ltar sems rang gnas su gnas pa gzings chags kyi nyams te gsum skye'o/ /de'i mtha' bral gyi nyams la brten nas nam mkha'/ stong pa/ khyab pa/ rtag pa'i nyams te chos bzhi ldan du skye bar 'gyur bas de bzhin du bskyangs te/ nam mkha'i mtha' la rab gnas pa/ /yid bzhin nor bu chen po 'chang / /zhes pa'i don no/ / dngos gzhi 'di la gnyis sam gsum bskyar nas sems la 'jags par byed do/ /gsum pa rjes la thun de las ldang ba na de ltar bsgoms pa la bsod nams dpag tu med pa yod pas/ dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di la brten nas 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog ces sogs ji ltar rigs pa'i bsngo ba dang smon lam bya/ chos thams cad kyi rtsa ba sems nyid nam mkha' lta bu dang / chos thams cad sems kyi cho 'phrul skye 'gag gnas gsum gyis stong pa nam mkha' lta bu yin pa la/ de ltar ma rtogs pa'i sems can rnams snying re rje zhes yun ring du bsam/ rjes thob kyi gnas skabs thams cad du sngar gyi nyams len gyi rgyun dran pa dang ma bral bar bya'o/ /de ltar sbyor dngos rjes gsum gyi sgo nas thog mar sems bzung ba'i dmigs pa'o/ /gnyis pa bar du de kho na nyid la blo bzhag pa la sbyor dngos rjes gsum las sbyor ba sngar sgom pa gsum dang gnad la dbab pa gsum rgyas bsdus ji ltar rigs pa re bshad/ bzhin/ dngos gzhi la lgang rgya bcag pa'i tshul du ming skye med bsam gyis mi khyab pa la sbyar ba dang / ba rgyang bral ba'i tshul du don skye med bsam gyis mi khyab pa la sbyar la/ kha chu bsal ba'i tshul du ting nge 'dzin nyid kyang skye med bsam gyis mi khyab pa la sbyar ba'o/

/dang po ni rnal 'byor pa rang nyid kyi ming lta bu/ ming gang yang rung ba zhig la/ ming de ma btags gong du gang du'ang grub pa med pas ma skyes skye med nam mkha' bzhin/ bar du ming de brjod de btags pa'i dus na ming ltar snang ba de brtags na gang du'ang ma grub pas skyes pa skye med nam mkha' bzhin/ ming de tha ma 'gag pa'i dus na 'dir 'gag bya ba med pas 'gag pa skye med nam mkha' bzhin te/ ming de dang po gang nas kyang ma skyes/ bar du gang du yang mi gnas/ mthar gang du yang mi 'gag pa nam mkha' lta bur shes par byas la mnyam par bzhag go /gnyis pa ni rang gi sems la nyon mongs pa gang rags brtags la zhe sdang lta bu gcig la thog mar skye ba rgyus stong ste nam mkha' lta bu/ bar du gnas pa ngo bos stong ste nam mkha' lta bu/ mthar 'gag pa 'bras bus stong ste nam mkha' lta bur shes par byas la mnyam par bzhag yang zhe sdang 'di gnas spyi bo nas rkang mthil bar du gang la gnas brtags pas gang du gnas mi rnyed/ rigs pho mo ma ning la sogs pa gang yin brtags pas gang yang ma yin te mi rnyed/ rang gi ngo bo dbyibs sam kha dog la sogs pa gang du grub brtags pas gang du'ang ma grub pas mi rnyed de skye med bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i ngang du mnyam par bzhag de bzhin du chos thams cad la sbyar te rnam par rtog pa gang dang gang yin pa de dang de sems nyid kyi ngang las ma g.yos shing / sems nyid nam mkha' ltar skye 'gag med pa'i ngang du lhod de mnyam par bzhag go /gsum pa ni bsgom bya sgom byed sgom pa po gsum yang nam mkha' ltar shes par byas nas nang du yid 'dzin med du bzhag pa dang / phyi rol tu shes pa lhug par bzhag pa gnyis las/ dang po ni shes pa kha nang du ldog ste sems rang gi rang bzhin gang du'ang ma grub pa de'i rang mdangs la rjen gyi lta zhing mnyam par bzhag go /gnyis pa gzugs dang sgra dang dri dang ro dang reg bya sogs gang la'ang sems spro bsdu mi bya bar shes pa rang lugs su lhug ge bzhag

yul gcig la sgom byed kyi shes pa gcig gis phyed du gtad nas mi bsgom par/ gang ltar mi sgom pa'i tshul gyis ci yang yid la mi bya ba de nyid la ma yengs par lan gnyis sam gsum gyi bar bskyar la ngo sprod mnyam par bzhag go /gsum pa rjes ni sngar bzhin no/ gong ma bzhin brjod do/ /gsum pa spyod lam thams cad du goms par bya ba la sbyor dngos rjes gsum las sbyor ba ni sngar bzhin/ gnad la dbab pa gsum dang bsgom pa gsum sngar bzhin brjod/ dngos gzhi la ting 'dzin de brtan zhing bogs dbyung ba'i phyir gzugs la bslab pa ni/ mig la nyi ma'i 'od zer mi 'ong bar byas te mdun du me tog sngon po lta bu zhig nye ring ran par bzhag de la rten mi 'gyur ba'i yan lag rten de g.yo 'gul med pa bya/ mig mi 'dzum pa'i yan lagamig de la lta/ lus mi 'gul ba'i yan lag lus gnad las g.yo ba med par bya/ yid 'dzin pa med pa'i yan lag dmigs rten la legs nyes la sogs pa'i dpyod pa btang ba sogs rtog pa'i spro bsdu mi bya bar/ rnam pa gsal bar 'char ba'i ngang nas shes pa 'dzin med rang lugs su bzhag de ltar yan lag bzhi ldan du byas nas bskyangs/ de nas gzugs gzhan la'ang de bzhin du sbyar te bsgoms pas mthar mig gi yul du gzugs gang mthong yang ting nge 'dzin skye ba'i grogs su 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin du sgra la sogs pa yul gzhan rnams la'ang yan lag bzhi ldan du bslab ste mnyam rjes khyad par med pa'i ting nge 'dzin ma skyes kyi bar du sgom mo/ /bzhi pa bsam gtan gyi gegs bying rgod bsal ba man chad yig rnying gi khrid yig gi lung la brten kyang chog khrid yig ni lung dang stabs gcig tu ngo sprad/ rjes sngar dang 'dra'o/ /de dag gis ni lam skor phyi ma brgyad kyi nang nas bsam mi khyab kyi dmigs rim ma tshang ba med par bstan zin to// //slob dpon chen po ḍom+bhi he ru ka'i lhan cig skyes grub kyi khrid la rgyu lhan cig skyes pa/

thabs lhan cig skyes pa/ 'bras bu lhan cig skyes pa dang gsum gyis lam rdzogs pa las/ rten gyi gang zag khyad chos gsum dang ldan pa zhig gis nyams su blang bya bskyed rdzogs gnyis nyams su blang ste/ ye shes skyes pa na spyod lam mtshams sbyar te 'bras bu grub pa las/ rten gyi gang zag rtog bcas dka' thub kyi lam pa dang / rtog med bu chung gi lam pa gnyis/ de gang la'ang lus chud ma zos pa/ ngag chud ma zos pa/ sems chud ma zos pa de gsum dang ldan pas sogs yig rnying gi nang blo nas 'thon pa'am/ yang na dpe thog nas ngo sprad/ dmigs rim med/ bzhin/ nyams su blang bya'i chos bskyed rdzogs gnyis kyi dang po bskyed pa'i rim pa ni 'grel pa lugs kyi mngon par rtogs pa yan lag drug pa nyams su blang ste/ lha'i spyan dbu ma nas bzung ste snod bcud rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor du ma shar gyi bar du sems 'dzin pa yin/ gnyis pa rdzogs rim la sngon 'gro rnams sngon du song zin nas/ dngos gzhi la rtog bcas dka' thub kyi lam dang / rtog med bu chung gi lam gnyis sam/ rang byin rlabs kyi lam dang / dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i lam gnyis las/ dang po rtog bcas dka' thub kyi lam rang byin rlabs sgom pa la/ sgom pa gsum gyi dang po gnyis 'dra/ rang yi dam du sgom pa kyai rdor zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug par sgom pa mngon rtogs mdzes rgyan nang bzhin gong ltar ngag tu brjod la bshad/ bca' ba lus kyi 'dug stangs pad+ma'i skyil krung ngam rdo rje'i skyil krung gang rung las rdo rje'i skyil krung bca'/ lag pa mnyam bzhag sogs bsam gtan gyi yan lag rnams tshang bar byas la/ sngon 'gro rlung sbyang ba ni rang kyai rdo rjer gsal ba'i lte ba'i nang du rlung kha dog sngon po du ba lta bu/ ngo bo mnyen pa/ rang bzhin stong pa sngo thul le ba zhig sgom ste/ lta ba sems kyi dmigs pa'o/

/de nas dgang ba rlung gi yan lag ni 'og sgo a long 'byed 'dzum gyi sbyor bas 'og rlung 'then pas/ de'i rkyen gyis lte ba'i rlung de yar phul te lhung bzed kha sbub pa lta bu ldir te song bar bsam la 'og rlung rdzogs par 'then/ de nas 'og rlung rang sor bzhag la/ steng rlung sna nas 'jam nar te drangs nas mnan pas lte ba'i rlung de mar phul te mar skyong ste song nas lhung bzed kha gyen du bstan pa ltar song bar bsam/ steng rlung ci thub kyi bar mnan/ mi thub pa dang rang sor bzhag de lta bu re mos kyis lan ci rigs pa bya/ de nas 'og rlung 'then pas rlung de snga ma ltar song bar bsam/ slar steng rlung mnan pas rlung de mnyen pa 'dril ba sgo nga lta bur bsam/ rlung kha sbyar thub tshad du bzung / mi thub pa dang rang sor bzhag dngos gzhi 'di lan gsum tsam bskyar/ /rjes dge ba bsngo gong bzhin/ spyod lam gyi gnas skabs thams cad du gzugs su snang ba sogs thams cad gau rī la sogs pa'i lhar shes pa'am/ yang na kyai rdo rjer shes pa'i ngang nas spyod lam bya'o/ /'di dag zhag grangs ci rigs par bsgoms te rlung sbyang ba'o/ /rlung 'dren pa la bsgom pa gsum dang lus kyi spyod lam rnams sngar bzhin bshad/ rang kyai rdo rjer gsal ba'i lte ba nas spyi gtsug gi bar gyi lus kyi dbus drang po na yar dbus su rtsa dbu ma kha dog dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa mda' smyug 'bring po tsam drang tal le yod pa/ de'i g.yas su ro ma dmar mo dang / g.yon du rkyang ma dkar mo gnyis gro sog 'bring po tsam/ gsum ka gshibs nas yod par bsam/ de ltar rtsa gsum yang nas yang du gsal gdab/ thebs pa dang mgo mdun du dgu ba dang bcas pas pho skad hūm̐ gi gdangs sam/ mo skad i'i gdangs gang rung gis rlung g.yas nas drangs pas des thur sel gyi rlung thams cad rtsa ro ma'i nang du drangs par bsam/

yang snga ma ltar g.yon nas drangs te thur sel gyi rlung thams cad g.yon rkyang ma'i nang du drangs par bsam la cung zad ngal gso/ de nas yang sngar bzhin drangs/ de ltar sbyangs pa'i gdangs kyis lus 'dar/ des rtsa 'dar/ des byang chub kyi sems 'dar te byang sems gyen la 'grong par 'gyur ro/ /rjes dge ba bsngo/ spyod lam gyi gnas skabs su zas bcud can tshod zin par bsten/ spyod pa bag yangs dang shes pa yul gyi steng du lhug par bzhag de ni rlung drangs pa'o/ /dngos gzhi rang byin rlabs kyi rnal 'byor nyams su blang ba la sgom pa gong bzhin gsum/ lus gnas la dbab pa rkang pa rdo rje'i skyil krung / sogs sngar bzhin/ ngag gnad la dbab pa rlung ro lan gsum sna bug nas phyi la sangs kyis 'bud/ sems gnad la dbab pa shes pa bzo med lhug par 'jog go 'di dag rgyas par na lam 'bras ltar bshad/ /dngos gzhi la rang kyai rdo rjer gsal ba'i lte ba nas spyi gtsug bar gyi lus kyi dbus drang po na yar dbus su rtsa dbu ma kha dog dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa/ de'i g.yas su ro ma dmar mo dang / g.yon du rkyang ma dkar mo/ gsum ka'ang sbom phra gro sog 'bring po tsam gshibs nas yod pa/ rtsa gsum mdud pa las byung ba'i lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lo rtsa 'dab drug cu rtsa bzhi pa'i dbus su rtsa mdud gru gsum gyi nang du nang ltar bshad pa'i rdo rje bdag med ma zhes bya ba aṃ dmar po mgo gyen bstan/ nang skor 'dab ma brgyad la dbyangs gsal sde tshan brgyad kyi thog ma a ka tsa ṭa ta pa ya sha brgyad kha dog dmar po g.yas bskor/ phyi skor 'dab ma drug cu rtsa bzhi la mdun nas g.yon bskor gyi a li bcu drug phrag gnyis/ g.yas bskor gyi ka li ha dang k+ṣa spangs pa phrag gcig ste thams cad kha dog dmar po mgo gyen la bstan pa/ snying kha chos kyi 'khor lo 'dab ma brgyad pa'i dbus su hūm̐ sngon po mgo thur la bstan pa/

phyogs bzhir bh+rūm̐ am̐ dz+ram̐ kham̐/ mtshams bzhir lam̐ mam̐ pam̐ tam̐/ yig 'bru thams cad kha dog nag po mgo thur la lta ba/ mgrin pa longs spyod kyi 'khor lo rtsa 'dab ma bcu drug pa'i dbus su oṃ dmar po mgo gyen bstan/ 'dab ma rnams la a li bcu drug g.yon skor/ yig 'bru thams cad kha dog dmar po mgo gyen la lta ba/ spyi bo bde ba chen po'i 'khor lo rtsa 'dab ma sum cu rtsa gnyis pa'i dbus su haṃ dkar po mgo thur bstan/ 'dab ma rnams la a li bcu drug phrag gnyis mdun nas g.yas bskor g.yon bskor/ yig 'bru thams cad kha dog dkar po mgo thur la lta ba/ bshang sgor las kyi rlung gzhu bdung pa lta bu dang / sum mdor ye shes kyi me gru gsum rang bzhin gyi gnas pa gsal btab/ de rnams gsal thebs pa dang 'og sgo 'byed 'dzum lan gsum byas pa'i tha ma la 'og rlung 'then pas bshang sgo'i rlung g.yos/ sum mdo'i me sbar/ lte ba'i am̐ la phog pas am̐ dmar hur gyis 'bar te me lce phra mo glog gi zer ma lta bu zhig g.yas ro ma nas song snying kha'i rtsa 'dab kyi yig 'bru'i khams rnams zhen thogs med par bcom/ yang ro ma nas song mgrin pa'i rtsa 'dab kyi yig 'bru'i khams rnams bcom/ slar yang ro ma nas yar song / me lce de nyid rang gi sna bug g.yas pa nas thon te phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi shangs bug g.yon nas zhugs/ de rnams kyi rtsa 'khor lo bzhi rnams me des yar ldog mar ldog byas pas/ de thams cad kyi dga' ba bzhi'i ye shes dang byin rlabs thams cad khyer te shangs bug g.yas nas thon/ rang gi sna bug g.yon nas zhugs/ spyi bo'i haṃ las babs pa'i bdud rtsi dang lhan cig 'dres pa g.yon rkyang ma nas babs/ mgrin pa'i yig 'bru rnams gsos btab cing rgyas par byas/ yang rkyang ma nas babs snying kha'i yig 'bru rnams gsos btab cing rgyas par byas/ yang rkyang ma nas babs te lte ba'i aṃ la phog pas/

aṃ khros te cher 'bar bas rtsa a wa dhu ti cung zad kha bye nas me lce shin tu phra ba glog gi zer ma'i tshul gyis a wa dhu ti nas yar song / snying kha'i hūm̐ zhen thogs med par bcom/ yang yar song mgrin pa'i oṃ zhen thogs med par bcom ste spyi bo'i haṃ la reg pas haṃ las bdud rtsi'i rgyun cha phra ba a wa dhu ti nyid nas babs te me des rim gyis bdas nas mgrin par babs/ oṃ gsos btab cing rgyas par byas/ snying khar babs hūm̐ gsos btab cing rgyas par byas/ lte ba'i aṃ la phog pas mas yar me 'bar ba dang / yas mar bdud rtsi 'dzag pa dang / dkar dmar skra shad 'dzings pa lta bu la sems drag tu gtad nas rlung kha sbyor bzung / mi thub pa dang rlung rang sor bzhag go /de lta bu yang nas yang du sgom/ mthar lus kyi 'phrul 'khor ma zhig par byas la mig mi 'dzum par bar snang la hrig gi lta/ sems gsal stong 'dzin med kyi ngang du ma bcos lhug par ci gnas kyi bar mnyam par bzhag ste chos thams cad bdag med pa'i lta bas rgyas gdab bo/ lan gnyis sam gsum gang rung bskyar la slob ma'i blo la 'jags par bya/ rjes dge bsngo'o/ /sogs gsum bsam gyis mi khyab kyi skabs bzhin bshad do/ / gnyis pa rtog med bu chung gi lam la dngos kyi phyag rgya la brten nas yig rnying nas 'byung ba bzhin yi ge nang bzhin bklags la ngo sprod dang / 'dir ye shes kyi phyag rgya sogs la brten nas dmigs pa sgom tshul la/ sngon 'gro mdangs bsgrub pa ni sngar gyi rlung sbyang ba dang drangs ba gnyis yin te sngar sngon du song ba des chog dngos gzhi ni sgom pa gsum dang lus gnad sogs bshad/ rang gi sems la mngon par 'dod pa'i mi'i bu mo dbang dang dam tshig thob la ma nyams pa zhig yid kyi yul du bya'o/ /de nas rang nyid kyai rdo rje dang rig ma bdag med mar sgom pa lha'i 'du shes/ yum gyi mkha' a las pad+ma dang /

rang gi gsang gnas hūm̐ las rdo rje byin gyis brlabs pa sngags kyi 'du shes/ thabs 'di la bsten nas lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes mngon du bya'o snyam pa chos kyi 'du shes te/ 'du shes gsum dang ldan pas rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma'i rtsa btsal te snyom par zhugs pas byang chub kyi sems rim gyis phab ste spyi bo nas mgrin par byon pas dga' ba/ mgrin pa nas snying khar byon pas mchog dga'/ snying kha nas lte bar byon pas dga' bral/ lte ba nas gsang gnas rtser byon pas lhan skyes rtogs par bsam/ de nas byang chub kyi sems rdo rje nor bu'i rtse mor gnas pa de nyid yar drangs te lte bar byon pas dga' ba/ snying khar byon pas mchog dga'/ mgrin par byon pas dga' bral/ spyi bor byon pas lhan skyes mngon du byas par bsam/ spyi bo nas thig le lus la grams te lus thams cad du khyab pas bde ba'i ye shes skyes par bsams la sems nyid spros pa dang bral ba bde ba'i 'khor lo gnas pa de'i ngang la ci gnas mnyam par bzhag par bya'o/ /rjes dge ba bsngo ba sogs snga ma bzhin bshad/ de dag gis ni lam skor phyi ma brgyad kyi nang nas lhan cig skyes grub kyi dmigs rim ma tshang ba med par bstan zin to// //slob dpon chen po pad+ma badz+ra gyi lam la thog mar lta ba 'khor 'das dbyer med du rtogs pa/ lam zhi gnas kyi sems gnas pa'i thabs dgu lam gyi sa mtshams dang bcas pa/ phyi rol gyi spros pa thams cad bcad pa zab pa'i tshul dgus nges shes bskyed pa/ 'bras bu sku gsum yan lag bdun ldan bstan pa dang bzhi las/ dang po la rgyu'i 'khor 'das dbyer med/ lam gyi 'khor 'das dbyer med/ 'bras bu'i 'khor 'das dbyer med dang gsum las/ dang po rgyu'i 'khor 'das dbyer med ni rje btsun rin po ches mdzad pa'i mtsho skyes kyi khrid yig bzhin ngo sprad/ gnyis pa ni bskyed pa'i rim pa la sems 'dzin pa yin pas/

de la'ang 'jug pa'i rim pa/ gnas pa'i rim pa/ ldang ba'i rim pa gsum gyi dang po la slob dpon 'di'i bzhed pa'i gang zag bzhi la mngon par rtogs pa dbri bskyed bzhi sbyor bar mdzad pa las/ gang zag las dang po pa'i rten gyi gang zag nyon mongs ba'i 'ching ba kun dang ldan pas a li ka li la ltos pa'i mngon byang gi bskyed chog nyams su len pa yin pas/ slob dpon 'di'i lugs kyi sgrub thabs yan lag bzhi pa/ mtsho skyes mdzes rgyan bzhin/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed rdo rje sems dpa'i sgom bzlas nas brtsams te/ rigs kyi bdag pos rgyas 'debs kyi bar sbyang gzhi sbyong byed ngo sprad cing shar sgom gyi tshul gyis nyams su len pa zhes sogs rgyud gsum mdzes rgyan gyi nang bzhin gzhan 'dra/ dag pa dran pa dkyil 'khor bsdus nas bya ba yin tshul bshad/ dmigs rim rgyas pa dkyus ltar nyi ma brgyad mdzad pa ni slob dpon 'di dang lam 'bras kyi thun mong ba yin pas de ltar bya ba'am/ bsdu na dag pa gsum gyi lugs bzhin byas kyang rung tsam yin gsungs/ te/ de dag la nges shes bskyed pa'i phyir rje btsun gyi khrid yig gis bcad lhag ma gsum po ngo sprod cing bklag go rdzogs pa'i rim pa la dmigs med kyi rdzogs pa'i rim pa dang / dmigs bcas kyi rdzogs rim pa gnyis las/ dang po ni dkyil 'khor bsdu ba'i zhar la dmigs med kyi rdzogs rim sgom ste/ thog mar bskyed rim sems 'dzin dang bcas pa sngar bzhin nyams su blangs/ bzlas pa byas te/ de nas rang gi thugs kha'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas khams gsum snod bcud thams cad 'od zer gyi rnam par gyur te srung ba'i 'khor lo la thim/ de dur khrod brgyad la/ de gzhal yas khang la/ de lha mo brgyad la/ de zhal brgyad la/ yum yang yab la/ yab kyi sku smad thugs kha'i zla ba la thim/ sku stod nyi ma la thim/ nyi zla gnyis kyang hūm̐ la thim par bsam/

hūm̐ de nyid shin tu 'od gsal ba la sems gtad de mnyam par bzhag de ni lha so so'i dag pa yin gsungs/ de nas hūm̐ gi zhabs kyu khog pa la/ de mgo bo la/ de zla tshes la/ de thig le la thim par bsam/ thig le de nyid mar me'i rtse mo ltar shin tu nas kyang 'od gsal ba sems gtad de mnyam par bzhag de ni rang rig pa'i dag pa yin gsungs/ thig le de nyid mthar je chung je phrar song ste nā da la thim/ nā da de nyid shin tu gsal ba la sems gtad/ de yang je phra je phra la song ste nam mkha' la sprin dengs pa bzhin du song bar bsam la yid 'dzin pa med pa'i ngang du ci gnas su mnyam par bzhag de ni de bzhin nyid kyi dag pa yin/ thun las ldang ba na chu las nya 'phar ba'i tshul gyis rang gtso bo yab yum gyi nga rgyal du langs la dag pa dran pa dang rdo rje'i glu dang smon lam bya'o/ /de ni dmigs med kyi 'di yan sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po ngag dbang kun dga' rin chen gyi gsung rtsom yin/ rdzogs rim mo/ /gnyis pa dmigs bcas kyi rdzogs rim la gcer bu tsaṇ+ḍa li 'khor lo gcig la brten pa/ nang gi grong khyer bcu drug pa 'khor lo gnyis la brten pa/ stug po tsaṇ+ḍa li 'khor lo'i bzhi la brten pa rnams yod pa las/ dang po ni sngar bskyed rim gyi skabs su bshad pa lta bu'i skyabs 'gro nas brtsams te mngon par rtogs pa mtsho skyes lugs nyams su blangs te de nas rdzogs rim sgom pa'o/ /de ltar mi nus na sgom pa gsum rgyud gsum mdzes rgyan gyi lta ba'i skabs bzhin bshad/ lhar sgom pa la zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug bsgom/ gnad la dbab pa rnam pa gsum sngar bzhin/ dngos bzhi ni rang kyai rdo rje yab yum gyi skur gsal ba'i lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lo sogs la brten nas sgom pa ste/ 'di gsum ga'i dmigs pa rgyud gsum mdzes rgyan nas 'byung ba'i/ 'khor lo gcig la brten pa/

gnyis la brten pa/ bzhi la brten pa de nyid sgra rgyud gsum mdzes rgyan bzhin bshad/ ji bzhin brjod do/ /rgya gzhung gi dngos bstan la dpa' bo gcig la brten pa'i nyams len ni lam lnga dang sbyar nas nyams su len pa ste gnas dben par stan bde ba la bsam gtan gyi spyod lam dang ldan pas 'dug pa ni tshogs lam/ lus ngag yid gsum cha mnyam ste rang babs su gnas pa ni sbyor lam/ de nas skyabs yul gsal btab ste/ bdag dang 'gro ba sogs skyabs 'gro dang / sems bskyed bla ma spyi bor sgom ste rang la bstim pa rnams sgom gsum bzhin bshad la/ rang skad gcig gis sku rdo rje he ru ka sku mdog sngon po g.yas rdo rje g.yon thod pa bsnams pa'i thugs khar 'og tu zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ steng du nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor sran ma phyed bkas tsam kha sbyar ba/ de gnyis kyi bar du hūm̐ yung kar gyi 'bru tsam sngon po gcig bsam/ de nas thugs kha'i 'og gi zla ba las 'od zer 'phros snod kyi 'jig rten thams cad gang / bcud kyi skye 'gro mo rigs thams cad la phog pas de thams cad 'od du zhu/ 'od zer gyi rnam par gyur nas tshur 'dus thugs ka'i zla nyi hūm̐ yig dang bcas pa la thim pas rang nyid skad cig gis rje btsun rdo rje bdag med ma sngon mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma g.yas gri gug g.yon thod pa 'dzin pa'i thugs kar zla nyi kha sbyar gyi bar du am̐ sngon po yungs 'bru tsam bsam/ yang thugs kha'i nyi ma las 'od zer 'phros/ snod kyi 'jig rten thams cad dang / bcud kyi skye 'gro pho rigs thams cad la phog pas/ de thams cad 'od du zhu/ 'od zer gyi rnam par gyur nas tshur 'dus/ thugs kha'i zla nyi am̐ yig dang bcas pa la thim pas/ rang he ru ka zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa yum bdag med ma dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i skur bsam/ yab kyi thugs kar zla nyi'i bar du hūm̐/ yum gyi thugs kar zla nyi'i bar du am̐ bsam la de la sems 'dzin/

de nas yum 'od du zhu nas am̐ la thim/ de yab kyi thugs ka'i zla ba la thim par bsam/ yab 'od du zhu ste thugs ka'i nyi ma la thim par bsam pa ni mthong lam mo/ /de nas nyi zla gnyis sran ma phyed bkas tsam gyi dbus su hūm̐ yungs kar tsam/ de'i mthar nyi ma la ka li phrag gnyis kha dog dmar po mgo thur bstan/ zla ba la a li phrag gnyis mgo gyen bstan kha dog dkar po skra'i rtse mo tsam du gnas pa la sems gtad pa sgom lam/ de nas hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas ka li 'od du zhu nas a li la thim/ a li zla ba la thim/ zla ba hūm̐ la thim/ steng gi nyi ma yang hūm̐ la thim/ hūm̐ gi zhabs kyu khog pa la/ khog pa mgo bo la/ mgo bo zla tshes la/ zla tshes thig le la thim pas thig le de mar me ltar shin tu gsal ba la sems gtad/ de'ang je phrar song ste nam mkha' la 'ja' yal ba ltar song bar bsam la yid 'dzin med du mnyam par 'jog pa ni mi slob lam ste/ de ltar lam lnga dang sbyar ba'i rim pas nyams su blang ngo / /thun las ldang ba na dge ba bsngo ba/ snying rje sgom pa/ spyod lam bya tshul sogs rgyud gsum mdzes rgyan gyi lta ba'i skabs bzhin bshad do/ /de dag gis ni lam skor phyi ma brgyad kyi nang nas slob dpon pad+ma ba'i lam gyi dmigs khrid ma tshang ba med par bstan zin to// //mchod rten drung thob ni slob dpon klu sgrub dpal gyi ri la gshegs pa'i tshe slob dpon 'phags pa lhas skyel thung mdzad pas/ khyod da dung sems thag ma chod dam gsungs nas mchod rten zhig gi drung du bzhugs nas sems thag gcod pa'i gdams ngag 'di gnang ba lags/ 'di la don lnga ste thog mar lta ba thag gcod/ de nas bsod nams kyi tshogs gsog bar du sems 'dzin/ de nas de kho nyid la ngo sprod/ rtogs pa skyes nas spyod pa dang mtshams sbyar ba'o/ /dang po ni gnad la dbab pa la gsum dang / sgom pa gsum sngar bzhin bya/ lhar bsgom pa kyai rdor dpa' bo gcig par sgom pas rung /

/dngos gzhi la 'di ltar bsam ste/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud las/ dngos po thams cad dang bral ba/ /phung po khams dang skye mched dang / /gzung dang 'dzin pa rnam par spangs/ /chos bdag med pa mnyam pa nyid/ /rang sems gdod nas ma skyes pa/ /stong pa nyid kyi rang bzhin no/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don phyi dang nang gi chos rnams phya'am dbang phyug la sogs pa byed pa pos kyang ma byas/ rdul phran la sogs pas byas pa'ang ma yin te/ rang gi sems nyid 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i bag chags kyis kun tu bslad pa/ dge ba dang mi dge ba'i las kyis grub pa rmi lam gyi rta glang la sogs pa lta bu yin te mdor na rang gi sems kyi snang ba yin no/ /sems de nyid kyang yang dag par brtags na/ dang po skye ba rgyus stong / bar du gnas pa ngo bos stong / mthar 'gag pa 'bras bus stong pa/ stong yang gsal ba ma 'gags pa'i 'od gsal ba'i rang bzhin/ gsal dus na stong la/ stong dus na gsal bas gsal stong dbyer med pa/ rang gi ngo bo smra bsam brjod pa'i yul las 'das pas brjod du med pa de'i ngang du mnyam par gzhag dgos te/ rje btsun rin po ches/ chos kun sems kyi spyod yul te/ /phya dang dbang phyug la sogs pa/ /'byung bzhi'i byed mkhan ma 'tshol bar/ /sems nyid kyi ngang la gang dgar zhog ces gsungs so/ /thun las ldang ba na dge ba bsngo ba gong bzhin/ thun mtshams rnams su'ang chos thams cad sems kyi snang ba dang / sems nyid spros pa dang bral bar shes pa'i ngang nas spyod lam bya'o/ /gnyis pa bsod nams kyi tshogs bsag pa ni phyi rol tu mun pa yod pa'i sa ma yin pa'i bsam gtan gyi khang pa nam mkha' gsal zhing dben pa zhig tu kha lho phyogs su bltas la sgrub pa'i maṇ+ḍal tshom bu lnga pa mtha' skor du ci 'byor ba'i mchod pa dang bcas pa bshams/ rang gi mdun du mchod pa'i maṇ+ḍal zhes pa nas brtsams te rgyud gsum mdzes rgyan gyi maṇ+ḍal gyi skabs bzhin brjod la/

maṇ+ḍal gyi yo byad rnams 'dus byas te gtsang sbra dang ldan pas mthong ba brgyud pa'i lag len ltar dbul bar bya ste/ de yang thog mar sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang la maṇ+ḍal dbul te/ ma tshang ba med pa 'di nyid sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang la dbul bar bgyi'o sogs lan du ma dbul/ de nas yi dam la dbul te/ yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams la dbul bar bgyi'o sogs brjod la tshar du ma dbul/ de nas brgyud pa'i bla ma la dbul te grub na bla ma re re bzhin du mtshan nas brjod de dbul/ de tsam mi 'grub na spyir dbul te/ brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams la dbul bar bgyi'o sogs brjod la tshar du ma dbul/ de nas rtsa ba'i bla ma la dbul te/ drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma la dbul bar bgyi'o sogs brjod la tshar mang du dbul te/ don dam bsnyen pa las thun mtshams rnams su/ shin tu rnam par dag pa yi zhes sogs nas/ skye ba kun tu yang dag bla ma dang / /zhes sogs ji ltar rigs pa'i bsngo ba dang smon lam bya'o zhes pa'i bar rgyud gsum mdzes rgyan gyi dkyus ltar brjod/ yang na lung rnams dang gsol gdab kyi tshigs bcad rnams ma byas kyang chog de nas rang yi dam du gsal ba'i spyi bor drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma de nyid nas brtsams te rdo rje 'chang gi bar gyi bla ma rnams tho brtsegs su bzhugs par bsam la/ sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang la skyabs su mchi'o/ /sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang la gsol ba 'debs so/ /sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang gis byin gyis rlobs shig de bzhin du rigs bsgres te gsang bdag phyag na rdo rje/ bram ze sa ra ha pa/ slob dpon 'phags pa klu sgrub/ slob dpon ār+yā de wa/ dge slong nag po zhabs pa/ slob dpon zla ba grags pa/ grub chen bram ze dpal 'dzin/ slob dpon dpa' bo rdo rje/ 'brog mi shākya ye shes/ de nas ngor chen rdo rje 'chang gi bar lam 'bras brgyud pa dang 'dra/

de nas mus chen sems dpa' chen po/ chos rje sangs rgyas dpal bzang / mus chen nam mkha' dpal bzang / rje btsun dkon mchog lhun grub/ sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po ngag dbang kun dga' rin chen/ yang na rje lhun grub zhabs kyi rjes su/ 'jam dbyangs sangs rgyas seṅge / paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang / rtse gdong bdag chen kun dga' bsod nams lhun grub/ yang na rje dkon mchog lhun grub kyi rjes su/ spyan snga rin po che 'jam dbyangs dkon mchog rgya mtsho/ mkhan chen byang chub dpal bzang / mkhan chen 'jam pa'i dbyangs ngag dbang chos grags/ yang shi'u lo tsā ba/ bla ma nam mkha' chos dar/ lo nas spyan snga rin po che kun dga' don 'grub ces brjod cing gsol ba btab pas gong ma rnams 'od du zhu nas 'og ma la thim par bsam la/ drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma la zhes sogs brjod pas rtsa ba'i bla ma rang la thim pas rang gi lus ngag yid gsum dang / bla ma'i sku gsung thugs dbyer med par bsams la mnyam par bzhag thun las ldang ba na skye ba kun tu sogs kyi smon lam bya/ thun mtshams rnams su yang sgo gsum longs spyod bcas pas bla ma'i zhabs tog tu ji 'gyur gyi thabs la 'bad par bya'o/ / maṇ+ḍal dang bla ma'i rnal 'byor bya tshul la yig cha so so nas mi 'dra ba dang rgyas bsdus bag re snang yang / 'dir rje btsun gyi gsung bzhin mdor bsdus pa'i lugs bris pa yin no/ /gsum pa bar du sems bzung ba ni gnad la dbab pa gsum dang / sgom pa gsum rgyud gsum mdzes rgyan bzhin brjod/ dngos gzhi ni/ 'jur bus bcings pa'i sems nyid ni/ /glod na grol bar the tshom med/ /ces bya ba yin pas sems khong lhod kyis glod la da ltar gyi shes pa 'di'i rang mdangs la bltas te/ yengs thabs su ma song bar rang gi so ma shor ba'i so ma/ rnam par rtog pas ma sgrims pa'i lhug pa/ gnyen pos ma bslad pa'i rang mdangs/ bzo med du ma bcos par bzhag

dge ba'i phyogs lha'i sku mdog la sogs pa'i rnam rtog nas/ mi dge ba'i phyogs gnod sems la sogs pa'i bar gyi rnam rtog bzang ngan gang gis kyang sems la las mi gzhol bar gang shar ba de la lta zhing dgag sgrub med par mnyam par bzhag de ltar byas shing bzhag pas sems zin nas gnas pa'i ting nge 'dzin skye'o/ /gal te rtag tu sems 'phro bar gyur te gnas su mi 'dod na/ sems kyi glang po yan du chug ces bya ba yin pas sems kyi bya ra ba bcug la gang dga' dgar btang zhes gsungs te/ gang 'phro ba de 'phro bar ngo shes pa'i dran pa'i bya ra ba dang ma bral ba'i ngang nas/ 'phro ba de la dgag sgrub dang yengs thabs su gar 'phros ma tshor bar ma song bar byas te 'phro ba ngos zin tsam du mnyam par bzhag de ltar btang bas rang sar log nas 'ong ste/ ji ltar gzings las 'phur ba'i bya rog ni/ skor zhing skor zhing slar yang de ru 'bab/ /ces bya ba'i don yin pas slar sems shugs chad de gnas pa'i ting nge 'dzin skye/ de ltar byas te mnyam par bzhag pas yid gzhan du mi 'phro bar gnas pa'i ting nge 'dzin skye'o/ /thun las ldang ba na dge ba bsngo ba sngar bzhin/ ngag tu brjod la bshad/ thun mtshams rnams su dran pa'i bya ra ba dang ma bral bar byas te nyams len gyi rgyun bskyang bar bya'o// //spyi don bzhi pa de kho na nyid ngo sprad pa la gsum ste/ dang po gsal ba ngos bzung ba/ bar du mtha' bral la blo sbyang ba/ tha ma brjod bral la nges shes bskyed pa'o/ /dang po la sngon 'gro sngar gnad la dbab pa gsum dang sgom pa gsum sngar bshad ltar bya/ dngos gzhi la/ chu dang mar me rang gsal cig tu zhog ces pa'i don yin pas sems kha nang du ldog ste da ltar gyi shes pa ma bcos pa'i rang lugs kyi steng du bzhag de yang sems kyi rang bzhin spros pa dang bral ba'i stong pa nyid yin kyang / ci med cang med kyi stong rkyang lta bu ma yin par gsal ba'i rang mdangs gsal sing nge /

ye re gnas pa dang ma bral ba'i gsal rig de'i ngo bo la rang la rang gis lta rgyu med pa'i tshul du bltas te mnyam par bzhag pas mthong rgyu med pa'i sems nyid gsal le hrig ge bar mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /gnyis pa ni byang chub sems 'grel las/ dmigs pa med pa'i sems su ni/ /bzhag pa nam mkha'i mtshan nyid yin/ /nam mkha' sgom pa de nyid ni/ /stong nyid sgom par bzhed pa yin/ /zhes bya ba'i don sgom pa yin pas rang gi sems la brtags la/ sems thog ma dang tha ma med pa nam mkha' lta bu/ skye ba dang 'jig pa med pa nam mkha' lta bu/ 'gro ba dang 'ong ba med pa nam mkha' lta bu/ mtha' dang dbus med pa nam mkha' lta bur dran par byas la mnyam par bzhag de las rnam rtog 'phro na 'das pa'i rjes mi dpyad ces bya ba sngar zin pa'i bya ba la bsam mno mi bya bar sems de'i rang mdangs la lta/ ma 'ongs pa'i sngon mi bsu zhes pa da 'di bya 'di byed kyi rnam rtog mi spro/ da lta ba la thug phrad ces pa rnam rtog gang skyed pa de ma yengs par ngo shes tsam gyi ngang la bzhag mdor na chos thams cad skye ba med par dran pa byas la sems nyid gsal stong 'dzin med/ mtha' bral ris med brjod bral blo 'das kyi ngang du bzhag go /de ltar yang sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor las/ e ma sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang / /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas skye ba med/ /skye ba med las thams cad skyes/ /skyes tsam nyid nas skye ba med/ /ces gsungs pa'i don yin no/ /gsum pa ni de ltar mnyam bzhag tu skyes pa'i nyams de dang / rjes kyi spyod lam thams cad bsre zhing / snang stong dbyer med/ gsal stong dbyer med/ rig stong dbyer med de brjod bral du shes pa'i ngang nas spyod lam bya ste/ do ha las/ gang la zhen pa yod na de yang thongs/ /rtogs par gyur na thams cad de yin te/ /de las gzhan zhig sus kyang shes mi 'gyur/ /zhes dang / glang chen lam nas sems tshags tshud pa ltar/

/'gro 'ong bcad na bdag yid dal ba ste/ /'di ltar rtogs pa ngo la bcos ci dgos/ /zhes bya ba'i don yin no/ /rjes dge ba bsngo ba gong bzhin bya'o/ /lnga pa ni rje btsun rin po che'i khrid yig nas 'byung ba ltar yin pas/ khrid yig steng nas snga ma rnams dang bcas pa ngo sprad do/ /de dag gis ni lam skor phyi ma brgyad kyi nang nas mchod rten drung thob kyi dmigs rim ma tshang ba med par bstan zin to// //gtum mo'i lam yongs su rdzogs pa la don lnga ste rgyud kyi rim pa/ sngags kyi rim pa/ ye shes kyi gsang ba'i rim pa/ gnyis su med pa'i rim pa'o/ /dang po la rgyas par na 'khor lo bde mchog nag po lugs kyi mngon par rtogs pa bsgoms la/ dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo rnams phyogs g.yon skor dang mtshams g.yas skor gyis sna bug g.yon dang g.yas nas bsdus la snying kha'i hūm̐ la thim par bsams nas gtso bo yab yum gyi nga rgyal gyis sgom pa yin la/ de tsam ma grub na gnad la dbab pa gsum dang / sgom pa gsum gyi dang po gnyis sngar bzhin ngag tu brjod la bshad/ rang yi dam gyi lhar sgom pa la srung 'khor dang gzhal yas khang 'dra/ hūm̐ zhes brjod pas rang nyid 'khor lo bde mchog sku mdog sngon po zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis pa/ yum phag mo dmar mo dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i skur lam gyis sgom/ de'i dpral bar sogs nas/ tha mal gyi rnam rtog gis mi rdzi ba'i dgos pa yod do/ /zhes pa'i bar rgyud gsum mdzes rgyan bzhin brjod/ dngos gzhi la rang bde mchog yab yum du gsal ba'i yum 'od du zhu nas yi ge bam̐ gyi rnam par gyur te rang gi lte ba'i aṃ la thim pas aṃ de shin tu gsal bar byas/ de las 'od byung nas 'khor lo rnams mas rim gyis gsal gdab ste/ bshang sgor yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor kha dog sngon po ba dan gyis mtshan pa/ sum mdor raṃ la me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum rtse mo gcig thur la bstan cing gyen la 'bar ba gsum gyis mtshan pa/

lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lo kha dog dmar po rtsa 'dab drug cu rtsa bzhi'i nang skor gyi 'dab ma brgyad la a ka tsa ṭa ta pa ya sha phyi skor 'dab ma lnga bcu rtsa drug la ka li so bzhi g.yas skor/ a li bcu drug gi steng du a i u e o am̐ ste dbyangs kyi thung ngu drug rnams g.yon skor/ lte ba'i dbus kyi lam mgo gyen bstan dang bcas pa/ snying kha chos kyi 'khor lo kha dog nag po rtsa 'dab brgyad pa'i dbus su hūm̐/ phyogs bzhir bh+rūm̐ am̐ dz+ram̐ kham̐/ mtshams bzhir ya ra la wa rnams mgo thur bstan/ mgrin pa longs spyod kyi 'khor lo kha dog dmar po rtsa 'dab bcu drug pa'i dbus su oṃ/ nang skor gyi 'dab ma bzhi la ā ī ū ai ste dbyangs kyi ring po bzhi/ phyi skor 'dab ma bcu gnyis la ri ṛ l̥ l̥̄ bzhi spangs pa'i dbyangs yig bcu gnyis rnams/ spyi bo bde ba chen po'i 'khor lo kha dog dkar po 'dab ma sum cu rtsa gnyis la yi ge dgod pa dang bral ba/ dbus su yi ge haṃ dkar po mgo thur bstan rnams bsam/ de dag gi dbus su g.yas su ro ma me'i rang bzhin kha dog dmar po gyen la lta ba/ de'i nang du a li mgo thur bstan re re'i bar du ka li mgo gyen bstan gnyis gnyis gnas pa/ g.yon du rkyang ma zla ba chu'i rang bzhin kha dog dkar po kha thur la lta ba/ de'i nang du a li mgo gyen bstan re re'i bar du ka li mgo thur bstan gnyis gnyis gnas pa/ ka li rnams kha dog dmar po dang / a li rnams dkar por bsgom/ dbus su a wa dhu ti ste rtsa dbu ma shin tu cha phra ba rta rnga brgyar bshags pa'i tshad tsam gyi kha dog dmar po drang la phra ba gsal gdab bo/ /de yang rlung phyir 'gro ba dang bstun la rtsa ro ma la brten te 'khor lo rnams mas rim gyi gsal gdab/ rlung nang du 'jug pa dang bstun te g.yon rkyang ma la brten te spyi bo nas lte ba'i bar du yas rim gyis gsal gdab/

rlung gnas pa dang bstun la dbu ma dang lte ba'i am̐ 'ba' zhig gsal gdab/ rlung dang ma bstun bar gsal btab kyang rung ste shin tu gsal bar ma gyur gyi bar du bsgom mo/ /rjes dge ba bsngo ba sogs sngar bzhin/ sngags kyi rim pa la gnad la dbab pa gsum dang / sgom pa gsum sngar bzhin/ sngags rim dngos la sbyor ba dang dngos gzhi gnyis kyi dang po ni/ 'og sgo 'byed 'dzum lan gsum byas pa'i tha ma la 'og rlung 'then pas des sum mdo'i me sbar/ de las me lce gcig chad de lte ba'i aṃ la phog pas aṃ de shin tu gsal bar byas pa la sems gtad/ 'bar ba'i rnam pa sogs su ni mi sgom gsungs/ de ltar bsgoms pas me de 'bar ba'i rnam pa dang / lte ba'i thad du drod skye ba sogs byung na dngos gzhi la 'jug gsung ngo / /gnyis pa dngos gzhi la las byed kyi 'khor lo gnyis/ rtsa gsum 'khor lo bzhi yig 'bru dang bcas pa gong ltar gsal btab la/ 'og sgo 'byed 'dzum lan gsum byas pa'i tha ma la 'og rlung 'then pas bshang sgo'i rlung g.yos/ des sum mdo'i me sbar/ des lte ba'i aṃ sbar te de las me lce gcig g.yas ro ma nas song / de'i nang gi yig 'bru rnams dang snying kha dang mgrin pa'i rtsa 'dab kyi yig 'bru rnams bsregs/ spyi bo'i haṃ la phog pas drod dang ldan par byas/ slar yang sna bug g.yas nas song / phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi shangs bug g.yon nas zhugs/ de rnams kyi 'khor lo bzhi la me de yar ldog mar ldog byas pas de rnams kyi 'khor lo bzhi la gnas pa'i byang sems bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin can de srin bu pad+mas khrag 'jibs pa ltar khyer te de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi shangs bug g.yas nas thon/ rang gi sna bug g.yon nas zhugs/ me de spyi bo'i haṃ la reg pas de las bdud rtsi'i rgyun 'dzag de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi bdud rtsi dang gcig tu 'dres pa g.yon rkyang ma nas babs mgrin pa dang snying kha'i yig 'bru rnams gsal bar byas/

lte ba'i aṃ la phog slar de las me lce gcig dbu ma'i nang du song / snying kha'i hūm̐ dang mgrin pa'i oṃ bcom/ spyi bo'i haṃ la phog de las byung ba'i byang chub kyi sems cher babs te mgrin pa'i oṃ dang snying kha'i hūm̐ gsos/ lte ba'i am̐ la phog pas lte ba'i gong sor bzhi tsam gyi thad sor mas yar me 'bar ba dang / yas mar bdud rtsi 'dzag pa gnyis dkar dmar skra bshad 'dzings pa lta bu la sems gtad la rlung sna nas rngubs te kha sbyor bzung / rlung mi thub pa dang dal bus btang ste sems 'dzin med du mnyam par bzhag go /rjes dge ba bsngo ba sogs gong bzhin ngag tu brjod de bshad/ 'dra'o/ gsum pa ye shes kyi rim pa la/ gnad la dbab pa gsum dang sgom pa gsum sngar bzhin/ rtsa gsum 'khor lo bzhi yi ge dang bcas pa sngar ltar gsal btab la 'og rlung 'then pas lte ba'i aṃ 'bar/ de las me lce zhig rtsa dbu ma'i nang nas yar song bas spyi bo'i haṃ la phog de las byang chub kyi sems babs pa spyi bo mgrin par sleb pas dga' ba'i ye shes skyes par bsam/ snying gar slebs pas mchog dga'i ye shes skyes par bsam/ lte bar slebs pas dga' bral gyi ye shes skyes par bsam/ rdo rje nor bu'i rtse mor slebs pas lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba skyes par bsam/ slar yang 'og rlung 'then pas thur sel gyi rlung gi nus pas byang sems rdo rje nor bu'i rtse mor gnas pa de nyid gyen du drangs te rdo rje'i rtse nas rtsa ba'i bar la cha bzhir byas pa'i/ cha dang po la dga' ba'i dga' ba/ gnyis pa la dga' ba'i mchog dga'/ gsum pa la dga' ba'i dga' bral/ bzhi pa la dga' ba'i lhan skyes skyes par bsam/ yang yar drangs te gsang gnas nas lte ba'i bar la cha bzhir byas pa'i cha dang po la mchog dga'i dga' ba/ gnyis pa la mchog dga'i mchog dga'/ gsum pa la mchog dga'i dga' bral/ bzhi pa la mchog dga'i lhan skyes/

lte ba nas snying kha'i bar la cha bzhir byas pa'i cha dang po la dga' bral gyi dga' ba/ gnyis pa la dga' bral gyi mchog dga'/ gsum pa la dga' bral gyi dga' bral/ bzhi pa la dga' bral gyi lhan skyes/ snying kha nas spyi gtsug gi bar la cha bzhir byas pa'i cha dang po la lhan skyes kyi dga' ba/ gnyis pa la lhan skyes kyi mchog dga'/ gsum pa la lhan skyes kyi dga' bral/ bzhi pa la lhan skyes kyi lhan skyes skyes par bsams te bde stong gi ngang la mnyam par bzhag 'di la rlung 'dzin mi dgos gsungs/ rjes dge ba bsngo ba sogs/ bzhi pa gsang ba'i rim pa ni gnad la dbab pa gsum dang / sgom pa gsum bshad/ rang lhar gsal ba'i sna bug gnyis kyi bar ka ba med pa sgo nga lta bur sgom/ de nas rlung phyir rgyu ba'i tshe rlung de nyid lus kyi nang nas byung ste sna'i rtog ma'i rtsar spos kyi dud pa 'khyil ba ltar 'khyil nas phyir mi 'gro bar bsam/ skabs 'dir rlung skyon sel ba'i tshul dkyus na gsal/ lnga pa gnyis su med pa'i rim pa ni rang gi sems dang sems las byung bar chos thams cad 'dus pas na phyi rol gyi yul gang la'ang mi rtog par/ nang gi sems kyi rtog pa byung tshor ci byung ba thams cad mi dmigs par bsgoms te/ de yang chu la chu bzhag pa ltar du bde stong dbyer med/ rig stong dbyer med de gnyis su med pa'i ngang la mnyam par bzhag go /rjes dge ba bsngo ba sogs gong bzhin bshad/ de dag gis ni lam skor phyi ma brgyad kyi nang nas gtum mo lam rdzogs kyi dmigs rim ma tshang ba med par bstan zin to// //phyag rgya chen po yi ge med pa'i gdam ngag la dang po brda'i sgo nas mkha' 'gros 'di dang gong gi bsam mi khyab kyi byin rlabs gnyis ka la bdag gi bla ma mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang chos grags kyi yig cha phyag len gyi rim pa shin tu gsal ba dang bcas mdzad yod pas gsung rab de nyid kyi steng nas byas kyang rung ba nyid do/

/byin gyis brlab pa la/ 'byung po'i nyi ma che chung gang rung la/ gnas dben par rdo rje bdag med ma lha mo bco lnga'i tshom bu dang mchod gtor sogs 'og tu dgos pa rnams bshams la/ sngon 'gro gtor ma/ gnas yo byin rlabs/ bdag med ma'i mngon par rtogs pa sgom bzlas/ tshom bu'i dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod bstod pa gtor ma rnams byas/ sa lha dang snyan gsan phab pa dang bum skyed ma dgos pa ma gtogs gzhan bdag med ma'i sta gon bzhin bya/ ye shes pa spyan 'dren gyi sngon du dam tshig gsum dran pa dang / bstod pa'i rjes su sdom bzung yang bya ste yab kyi maṇ+ḍal mchod chog dang 'dra bar bya'o/ /de nas slob ma dbang gis smin pa khrus byas/ phyag dang yon phul nas 'khod pa la sems skyed gsal btab pa nas lam skor phyi ma brgyad kyi khrid rnams 'chad par byed pa la zhes pa'i bar gong bzhin/ slob dpon ngag gi dbang phyug grags pa'i phyag rgya chen po yi ge med pa'i gdam ngag la don gsum ste/ thog mar bya rgod kyi 'jug stegs bca' ba dang 'dra bar mkha' 'gros byin gyis brlab pa dang / bar du lam sgom pa dang / 'bras bu sku gsum yan lag bdun ldan no/ /dang po la slob dpon gyi bya ba rnams sngon du song nas/ byin rlabs zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal phul/ 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ stong pa'i snying po phyag 'tshal bstod/ /rtog pa thams cad yang dag spangs/ /thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes tshogs/ /ye shes sku la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /lan gsum/ 'gro ba'i mi shes gcod mdzad cing / /dag pa'i de nyid ston mdzad pa/ /bdag med chos las byung ba yi/ /rdo rje gsung la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /lan gsum/ rdzogs sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems/ /pha rol phyin pa'i yon tan rnams/ /mgon po las ni rtag tu byung / /thabs chen mchog la phyag 'tshal bstod/ lan gsum/ kun mkhyen ye shes phung po can/ /srid pa'i 'khor lo rnam sbyong ba/

/de ring bshad pa'i rin chen gyis/ /gtso bos bdag la bka' drin skyobs/ /lan gsum/ de ltar bstod pa dang gsol ba btab nas/ bla ma la sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang dngos yin snyam pa'i gus 'dud dang ldan pas lus tsog bu/ rkang pa gnyis gshibs te 'phong sa la ma reg par bsdad la chos thams cad rmi lam ltar snang la bden par ma grub par shes pa'i ngang nas dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ khyed rang gi mdun du shing sdong shin tu ring ba zhig sgoms/ de nas rang gi lus gcer bur gyur pa de gnyis su phye nas gcig shing sdong gi rtsa bar tsog bur bsdad/ gcig shing sdong de la 'dzegs te shing gi rtse mor tsog bur bsdad par bsams la/ shing gi rtsa bar yod pa'i lus de la bltas te bdag gi lus de steng 'og gang yin brtag de la g.yang za ba'i 'jigs pa shugs kyis 'byung / bdag gi lus ni rtsa ba'i de dang rtse mo'i de gnyis gang yang yin la gang yang min pas bden par med par thag bcad/ yang shing rtse'i rang de nyi zla'i 'od zer la 'jus te phyin nas nyi zla'i steng du bsdad la gling bzhir lta/ yar shing gi rtse mo la sems drag tu gtad/ shing gi rtsa ba na 'dug pa'i bdag gi lus rnying pa la bltas te/ bdag gi lus sogs gong bzhin thag bcad/ de ltar bden par med par rtogs nas rtog pa gang du'ang ma 'phros pa'i sems nyid skye ba med pa de yi ge med pa'i don yin no/ /zhes brjod la lus kyis slob ma la bdud rtsi gtor/ ngag gis rnal 'byor ma'i phreng sngags bzlas/ sems kyis rang gi thugs kha dang mdun skyed kyi thugs kha nas sngags phreng kha dog dmar po 'phros slob ma'i lus la khyab par zhugs/ snying kha'i hūm̐ de dmar lam lam song bar bsam/ gu gul gyi dud pa bya'o/ slob dpon gyis ḍā ma ru'i sgra cung zad bya/ /de nas dper na bung ba me tog la zhen pa med cing sbrang rtsi gzhibs nas 'gro ba ltar/

yul du gang snang ba'i snang ba 'di dag thams cad rang gi sems kyi snang ba tsam/ de yang sgyu ma'i snang ba ltar snang la rang bzhin med pa/ de yang nam mkha' ltar spros pa dang bral ba'i de kho na nyid yi ge med pa yin te/ yul la zhen pa med par sems spros bral gyi ngang du zhog cig de mtshon par byed pa de kho na nyid kyi glu 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ khong stong khyed kyi sku la med/ /sha dang rus pa khrag kyang med/ /nam mkha' la ni 'ja' tshon bzhin/ /khyed kyi sku ni ston par mdzad/ /oṃ āḥ.aṃ āṃ iṃ īṃ uṃ ūṃ/ riṃ rīṃ liṃ līṃ/ eṃ aiṃ/ oṃ auṃ/ am̐ hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ sku la bsnyun med mi gtsang med/ /bkres dang skom pa 'byung med kyang / /khyod ni 'jig rten rjes 'jug phyir/ /'jig rten bya ba ston par mdzad/ /oṃ āḥsogs brjod/ chu zla bzhin du bzung du med/ /chos rnams kun la gnas pa med/ /nga rgyal med cing rmongs pa med/ /dmigs med khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /oṃ sogs/ gshegs dang bzhugs dang de bzhin gzims/ /spyod lam dag ni thams cad du/ /khyod ni rtag tu mnyam 'jog pa/ /dmigs med khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /oṃ sogs/ sgyu ma lta bu'i ting 'dzin gyis/ /rdzu 'phrul che la rnam 'phrul cing / /sna tshogs min la snyoms 'jug pa'i/ /dmigs med khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /oṃ sogs/ zhes glu blangs pas de kho na nyid la nges shes skyes par mos la de'i ngang la mnyam par zhog cig ces brjod la cung zad mnyam par bzhag rjes gtso bos/ maṇ+ḍal/ deng nas sogs 'dra/ slob dpon gyis rjes chog bya'o/ /de nas sems bskyed gsal 'debs nas bzung yan lag bdun ldan no/ /zhes pa'i bar sngar bzhin no/ /de la dang po sngon du song nas de ltar byin rlabs kyi rgyun dang ldan pa de la gdams ngag bstan par bya ste/ gnyis pa lam bsgom par gsum/ dang po sems bzung ba/ bar du sems 'dul ba/

tha ma de kho na nyid la blo bzhag pa'o/ /dang po la gnad la dbab pa gsum dang / sgom pa gnyis bsam mi khyab kyi skabs bzhin bya/ dngos gzhi la'ang gsum ste song sar bzung / bzhag sar bskyangs/ mtha' gnyis spang ba'o/ /dang po ni rang gi sems gang du song sa zhig tu dran pa'i thag pas bzung ba ste/ rang gi sems dkon mchog gi rten lta bu la 'phros na de nyid du bzung ste gnas par byed pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni de las gzhan du shor du mi gzhug par bzung ba'o/ /gsum pa ni 'das pa dang ma 'ongs pa'i spro sdu mi sems pa'o/ /sngar byin rlabs dus kyi dmigs pa la brten nas kyang bzung ste/ rang gi mdun du shing sdong shin tu ring ba zhes pa nas/ yi ge med pa'i don yin pas de'i ngang du mnyam par bzhag go /gnyis par bar du sems 'dul ba la song sar shor mi gzhug zhag sar lam du mi gzhug gong 'og tu tha dad du mi gzhug pa dang gsum las/ dang po ni sems gang du 'gro yang dran pa'i thag pas btags nas dran pas ma zin pa'i sems rkyang par shor du mi gzhug pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni bzhag sar btag nas zhi gnas su song ba nyan thos su gol bas na/ yang gzhan zhig gi steng du sems bzung la dkyil 'khor du mi gzhug go /gsum pa ni sems 'phro ba'i dbang du yang mi gtong / zhi gnas lteng po'i dbang du yang mi gtong bar sems la dbang thob par bsgom pa'o/ /rjes dge ba bsngo ba sogs bshad/ gsum pa de kho na nyid la blo bzhag pa ni gnad la dbab pa gsum dang / bsgom pa gsum bshad/ dngos gzhi la dpe la slob pa/ don la sbyar ba/ dpe don bsre ba dang gsum las/ dang po ni sgyu ma'i dpe bcu gnyis la bslab ste/ smig rgyu la sbyar na/ lung pa thams cad smig rgyu'i chus gang bar mthong ste/ 'di rnams chu'i rgya mtsho yin snyam pa ni 'khrul ba'i dus/ de nas mar phyin tsa na chu ma yin par mthong ste/ 'di ni chu ma yin la smig rgyur 'dug go snyam pa ni 'khrul par go ba'i dus/

de nas smig rgyu nyid kyang brtags shing dpyad pas gang du'ang ma grub par shes pa ni 'khrul pa gzhi med du khong du chud pa'i dus so/ /gnyis pa don la sbyar ba la dran snang la sbyar ba dang / dmigs pa la bslab pa gnyis/ dang po ni nyon mongs pa zhe sdang skyes pa ni 'khrul ba'i dus/ de nas de zhi ba ni 'khrul par go ba'i dus/ de mi bden par rtogs pa ni 'khrul pa gzhi med du khong du chud pa'i dus so/ /des na zhe sdang de rang gi sems/ sems rgyu rkyen las byung bas sgyu ma/ de brtags na mi brnyed pa rang bzhin med pa ste phyag rgya chen po'i yi ge med pa'o/ /de la yi ge zhes bya ba ni rnam rtog yin zhing brjod pa yin la/ rnam rtog med cing brjod du med la brjod pa dang bral ba la phyag rgya chen po yi ge med pa zhes bya'o/ /de bzhin du nyon mongs pa so so la sbyar zhing bsgom par bya'o/ /gnyis pa la 'ching byed kyi lus sems btang ba/ 'dzin byed kyi longs spyod btang ba/ rnam grangs gzhan la bslab pa'o/ /dang po ni mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma dang yi dam spyan drangs la dgra dang gnyen du 'dzin pa phul/ rang gi lus kyang gtubs la phul te/ de rnams kyang rang gi sems/ sems sgyu ma/ sgyu ma rang bzhin med pa ste phyag rgya chen po yi ge med pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni rang gi longs spyod thams cad bla ma la phul la/ longs spyod de dag kyang thog ma med pa'i dus nas sems 'khrul ba'i dbang gis snang ba 'khrul ba'i dus/ sems 'khrul pa'i snang ba tsam du shes pa 'khrul par go ba'i dus/ de nyid sems/ sems sgyu ma/ sgyu ma rang bzhin med pa phyag rgya chen po yi ge med pa'i don ni 'khrul pa gzhi med du khong du chud pa'i dus so/ /gsum pa ni dmyal bar phyin la sdug bsngal myong bar bsam/ sdug bsngal 'di las thar bar bya snyam du bsam/ de dag kyang sems/ sgyu ma/ rang bzhin med par shes par bya/

yang phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing rnams lta bar bsam/ de rnams mthong ba ngo mtshar snyam du bsam/ de dag kyang sems/ de'ang sgyu ma/ de'ang rang bzhin med pa phyag rgya chen po yi ge med pa'o/ /gsum pa dpe don bsre ba la rtsol ba dang bcas pa dang / rtsol ba med pa dang / grub pa'i rtags dang gsum las/ dang po ni/ sgyu ma dang nyon mongs sogs la/ sems dang / sgyu ma dang / rang bzhin med pa dang phyag rgya chen po yi ge med pa'o zhes rtsol bas yid la byed pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni de ltar yid byed kyi rtsol ba med par rang shugs kyis rtogs pa'o/ /gsum pa la rtsol ba dang bcas pa'i 'bras bu ni mnyam rjes la khyad par yod pa'o/ /rtsol ba med pa'i 'bras bu ni mnyam rjes la khyad par med par rang gi ngang gis 'jug pa'o/ /rjes dge la bsngo ba sogs bshad/ gsum pa 'bras bu sku gsum yan lag bdun ldan sogs 'di dag gi don rgyas par rje btsun rin po che'i yig rnying gi steng nas zhib par ngo sprad do/ /gsung las rtogs par bya'o/ /de dag gis ni lam skor phyi ma brgyad kyi nang nas yi ge med pa'i man ngag gi dmigs rim ma tshang ba med pa bstan zin to// //yon po srong ba ni rtsa yon po ni ro rkyang gnyis/ rlung yon po ni ldang 'jug gnyis/ thig le yon po ni khu khrag gnyis te de rnams srong ba ni dbu mar tshud pa ste/ rtsa dang rlung dang byang chub kyi sems 'chings nas sangs rgyas kyi lam du 'gyur ba yin no/ /de nyams su len pa la gnad la dbab pa gsum dang / sgom pa gsum gong bzhin bshad/ yi dam sgom pa bde mchog bya/ dngos gzhi la/ khro bo'i gzugs kyi rlung bzung na/ /skra dkar gnyer ma rnam spangs te/ /rga dang 'chi ba las grol nas/ /nam mkha' bzhin du 'chi med 'gyur/ /zhes te lus skyil krung legs par bca'/ lag pa gnyis rdo rje khu tshur legs par bcangs la pus mo gnyis kyi steng du bzhag

mig mi 'dzum par gyen la bzlog lce rkan la sbyar/ so bsgrigs te kha bgrad la/ 'og rlung cung zad bskum/ steng rlung rdzogs par rngubs te brang rus man chad du mnan/ 'og rlung de cung zad yar 'then la kha sbyar te/ lto ba tshigs pa la sbyar/ lag pa gnyis pus mo'i steng nas phar la gru mo pus mo la sleb sleb btang zhing lus thams cad nya sul 'thon par bsgrims nas lus cung zad mdar ba tsam bya'o/ /rlung mi thub pa snyam na dal bus glod de/ yang sngar bzhin bsgom mo/ /de lta bu lan nyi shu rtsa re byas la mthar lte ba brkyangs te lus kyi 'phrul 'khor ma zhig par byas la/ mig mi 'dzum par bar snang la hrig ge lta/ sems gsal stong 'dzin med kyi ngang du ma bcos lhug par bzhag 'phrul 'khor gzhan rnams dang gegs sel dang 'bras bu sogs rje btsun gyi gsung rab las gsungs pa bzhin no/ /rjes dge ba bsngo ba sogs dang / yig rnying gi steng nas lung dang sbrags te zhib tu ngo sprad do/ /de dag gis ni lam skor phyi ma brgyad kyi nang nas yon po bsrang ba'i man ngag gi dmigs rim ma lus pa bstan zin to// //rgyal chen in+d+ra bhū ti'i phyag rgya'i lam ni dngos kyi phyag rgya'i nyams len yin pas yig rnying gi nang nas ji ltar 'byung ba bzhin nyams su blang yig rnying gi lung byas te ngo sprad pa'am/ de'i nang bzhin ngag tu brjod nus na blo la blangs te brjod do/ /dgos te/ 'dir ye shes kyi phyag rgya la bsten pa'i dmigs rim tsam brjod na/ 'di la man ngag gi gzhi bca' ba la brgyud pa bzhi dang / lam lnga dang / sdom pa gsum dang ldan pa ste gsum yin la/ nyams su blang ba'i gnad ni lngar 'dus shing / dga' ba bcu drug dang phyi nang gi yul sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi tshul gyis sa bcu gnyis kyi bgrod tshul bstan la/ yan lag lnga'am bdun gyis 'bras bu sangs rgyas kyi sa bstan pa las/ gzhan rnams rje btsun 'khrul ba'i dri ma zad pa grags pa'i gsung bzhin shes par bya zhing /

ye shes kyi rig ma la bsten nas nyams su blang ba'i gnad lnga bstan pa la/ gnad la dbab pa rnam pa gsum dang sgom pa gsum ni rgyud gsum mdzes rgyan gyi lta ba'i skabs ji lta bar bzhin bshad/ gnyis pa dngos bzhi la lnga ste rig ma dag pa/ lus ngag mnyam pa/ byin rlabs mnyam pa/ 'dod pa mnyam pa/ man ngag gi gnad kyis zin pa'o/ /zhes pa nas brtsams te rgyud gsum mdzes rgyan gyi sher dbang gi lam rgyas pa bzhin brjod/ man ngag gi gnad lnga pa mi nyams par bsrung ba la brgyad yod pa ni yig rnying las 'byung ba ltar yin no/ /lam de bsgoms pa las byung ba'i lhan skyes kyi ye shes dga' ba bcu drug yod pa thams cad dga' ba bzhi bzhir 'dus pas dga' ba bzhi ni khams bdud rtsi la gnad du bsnun pa las skye/ zhes pa nas bde ba dang stong pa gnyis su med pa lhan skyes so zhes pa rgyud gsum mdzes rgyan bzhin brjod/ de dag la brten nas sa lam rnams rim gyis bgrod de 'bras bu kha sbyor yan lag bdun ldan mngon du byed pa yin no/ /rjes dge ba bsngo ba sogs gong bzhin bshad/ de dag gis ni lam skor phyi ma brgyad kyi nang nas rgyal chen in+d+ra bhū ti'i lam gyi dmigs rim ma lus pa bstan zin nas/ de ltar lam skor phyi ma brgyad lam 'bras dang bcas pa'i gdams pa zab mo 'di dag grub pa'i slob dpon su dang su zhig gis/ rgyud sde rin po che gang dang gang la brten nas gzhung yan lag 'di dang 'dis mdzad kyi rnam bzhag cung zad brjod na/ de yang bla ma dam pa'i chos 'byung yan chad du gang zag brgyad kyis mdzad pa'i lam skor dgu zhes pa kho na yod kyang / rdo rje 'chang gi lo rgyus kyi yi ge la zhib brtags mdzad pas nag po pa la gnyis su 'byed dgos pa gsal bar dgongs nas chos 'byung bstan pa rgyas pa'i nyi 'od man chad dpal ldan ngor pa'i rjes 'jug rnams gang zag dgus mdzad pa'i lam skor dgu zhes 'dod de/

de yang re re la mdzad pa po'i gang zag rgyud gzhung gang la brten nas mdzad pa/ gzhung gang mdzad pa/ don nyams len gyi khrid ngos bzung ba dang bzhi bzhis 'chad pa las/ gang zag ni rdo rje gdan pas grub thob brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i bstod pa re dang sbyar nas ngos 'dzin te/ /chu bo chen po gyen la bzlog ces sogs ltar gyi bir+wa pas spyir bka' mdo rgyud/ bye brag tu bla med/ khyad par du rgyud gsum/ de'i nang nas kyang gtso bor brtag gnyis la brten nas gzhung rdo rje tshig rkang mdzad/ nyams len gyi khrid gsung ngag rin po che'o/ /bir+wa pa la rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug bir+wa pa dang / shar phyogs bir+wa pa gnyis las 'di snga ma'o/ /dge slong lus la dngos grub brnyes/ /nags kyi lha mos bdud rtsi phul/ /klu sgrub snying po zhes bya ba'i/ /bla ma de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pa ltar gyi gang zag 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis rgyud gsang 'dus le'u gnyis pa/ rnam snang byang chub sems le la brten nas gzhung byang chub sems 'grel mdzad/ nyams len gyi khrid mchod rten drung thob/ rgyal rigs zla ba'i dngos grub brnyes/ /pad+ma can dang lhan cig bzhugs/ /mtsho skyes rdo rje zhes bya ba'i/ /bla ma de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pa ltar gyi mtsho skyes rdo rjes rgyud 'bum phrag lnga ba'am/ brtag gnyis la brten nas gzhung bskyed rim sgrub thabs mtsho skyes/ rdzogs rim mar me'i rtse mo lta bu mdzad/ nyams len gyi khrid bskyed rim zab mo'i tshul dgu bsnyen sgrub bzhi cha dbri ba dang bcas pa'o/ /mtsho skyes la che chung gsum las/ dang po yan lag med pa'i rdo rje/ 'di de'i slob ma ste bar pa la ngos bzung nas bod du byon tshul sogs byed pa zhig rdo rje 'chang gi chos 'byung du gsungs so/ /rje btsun gyis lam skor gyi lo rgyus kyi yi ge ltar na mtsho skyes chung bas bod du byon pa 'thad pa'i phyogs shig yod gsungs/

gding ba bting nas gaṅgā brgal/ /stag la zhon nas dngos grub brnyes/ /ḍom+bhi pa zhes bya ba yi/ /bla ma de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pa ltar gyi ḍom+bhi pas rgyud brtag gnyis la brten nas gzhung lhan cig skyes grub mdzad/ nyams len gyi khrid lhan cig skyes pa gsum gyis lam yongs su rdzogs pa'o/ /ḍom+bhi pa la/ ḍom+bhi he ru ka dpal mchog ḍom+bhi pa che chung gnyis te gsum las 'di dang po'o/ /zar bu'i lus la shing mkhan rigs/ /mu dra ma dang dngos grub brnyes/ /tog rtse pa zhes bya ba yi/ /bla ma zhes pa ltar gyi gang zag tog rtse pas rgyud sam+bu ṭi las gzhung bsam gyis mi khyab mdzad/ nyams len gyi khrid bsam gyis mi khyab pa lngas lam yongs su rdzogs pa'o/ /rgyal rigs u rgyan gnas na bzhugs/ /lcam sring gnyis kyis dngos grub brnyes/ /in+d+ra bhū ti zhes bya ba'i/ /bla ma zhes pa ltar gyi gang zag in+d+ra bhū tis rgyud ye shes thig le la brten nas gzhung dbang yon tan rim pa mdzad/ nyams len gyi khrid phyag rgya lam rdzogs so/ /in+d+ra bhū ti la che chung gsum las 'di bar pa'o/ /de gsum min pa gcig kyang yod gsungs/ bla ma'i bka' bcag spyod pa mdzad/ /srid pa bar dor rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /nag po spyod pa zhes bya ba'i/ /bla ma zhes pa ltar gyi gang zag nag po spyod pas rgyud bde mchog rtsa bshad la brten nas gzhung o la pa ti mkha' 'gro'i brda' skad/ bod skad du nag po rim bzhi zhes 'byung ba de mdzad/ nyams len gyi khrid gtum mo lam rdzogs/ nag po pa la nag po spyod pa/ shar phyogs nag po pa/ nag po dam tshig rdo rje/ nag po shan+ta bha dra la sogs pa mang dag yod pa las/ 'di dang po yin pa sho gzhag go /rgyal rigs nyi ma'i zer la gshegs/ /ril bu mig sman sa 'og spyod/ /ngag dbang grags pa zhes bya ba'i/ /bla ma zhes pa ltar gyi gang zag ngag dbang grags pas/ rgyud brtag gnyis dang gsang 'dus la brten gzhung bzhi pa snang ba/

yan lag bdun ldan/ de kho na nyid/ rin chen phreng ba de gsum mdzad/ nyams len gyi khrid phyag chen yi ge med pa'o/ /dka' thub bor nas spyod pa mdzad/ /lta stangs mdzad cing dngos grub brnyes/ /nag po pa zhes bya ba yi/ /bla ma zhes pa ltar gyi gang zag nag po u tsi ṭa 'chi ba med pas ma rgyud mtha' dag la brten nas gzhung rlung sems dbang du 'jug pa'i tshigs su bcad pa gcig mdzad/ nyams kyi khrid yon po srong ba'o/ /don de dag la dgongs nas rje btsun rin po ches lam skor dgu ni khyad par ro/ /zhes gsungs shing / chos rje pas kyang / lam 'bras la sogs lam skor dgu/ /zhes bshad pa yin la/ lam skor phyi ma brgyad po de rnams kyi sdom ni rje btsun grags pa'i gsung sgo rum dpe rnying las rje btsun dngos kyi phyag bris nyid la yod ces bla ma gong ma rnams kyis gsungs/ gis/ zhing pa'i bya ba bsam gyis mi khyab tog rtse pa kyang / /mtsho skyes slob dpon bzhin du zab pa'i tshul spyod pa/ /ḍom+bhi he ru ka bas kyang lhan cig skyes pa grub/ /dpal ldan nag po spyod pa khro zhing gtum pas ni/ /mtha' nag po pa u tsi ṭa 'chi ba med pa gnyis g.yo ba dbu ma'i lam bcug nas/ /'phags pa klu sgrub bzhin du sems thag chod par gyur/ /rgyal in+d+ra bhu ti po'i tshul du btsun mo'i tshogs bsten na/ /yi ge med dang slob dpon ngag gi dbang phyug thob/ /ces gsungs shing / des na lam 'bras la sogs pa'i lam skor dgu bod du dar bar mdzad mkhan ni 'brog mi lo tsā ba chen po de nyid yin pas/ lo chen de nyid kyis lam skor phyi ma rnams skyes mchog gang dang gang la gsan pa yin snyam na ji skad du/ lo chen de yis lam skor phyi ma rnams/ /skyes mchog gang dang gang la gsan snyam na/ /pad+ma'i lam dang gtum mo lam rdzogs dang / /yon po bsrang rnams ga ya dha rar gsan/

/mchod rten drung thob lhan cig skyes grub dang / /bsam mi khyab rnams dpa' bo rdo rjer gsan/ /mkhas shing grub pa brnyes pa a mo gha/ /badz+ra zhabs la phyag rgya lam rdzogs dang / /shes rab gsang bar yi ge med pa gsan/ /zhes pa ltar ro/ /de ltar na rtsod pa'i dus kyi rdo rje 'chang 'brog mi lo tsā ba shākya ye shes kyis gangs ri'i khrod 'dir gsal bar mdzad pa'i lam skor phyi ma brgyad kyi khrid rim rje btsun sa skya pa yab sras rnams kyi thugs dam nyams bzhes kyi snying po mtha' yas rgyud sde'i mnga' bdag rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang pos dar rgyas su mdzad pa'i bka' srol ji lta ba bzhin bstan zin pa yin pas thos pa dang bsam pas tshul bzhin du bskyangs te sgom pas nyams su len pa dang / skal ldan gyi gdul bya la legs par bstan pa'i sgo nas rang gzhan gyi don rgya chen po mdzad par zhu/ bsod nams 'di yis thams cad gzigs pa nyid/ /ces sogs dang / bsngo ba dang smon lam rgyas par bya'o/ /de ltar lam skor gyi khrid 'di rnams dkyus gcig la bar ma chad par gtong na sngon 'gro'i bsag sbyangs gcig gis chog par mdzad/ yang bar mtshams bzhag nas 'jug dgos pa byung na gang 'jug pa'i mtshams der bsag sbyang sogs khrid kyi sngon 'gro re cis kyang gtong dgos/ 'di dag la go rim gyi nges pa mi dgos pas rim pa ji ltar byas kyang rung ba yin no/ /gong du chos thun rnams kyi dbur yig brgya/ chos gtor/ maṇ+ḍal rnams bya bar gsung pa'i phyag len ni/ slob ma rnams 'dus grub 'phral bla mas bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa' dpal he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes brjod de dpon slob lhan cig tu yi ge brgya pa nyer gcig sogs kyi mthar/ bla ma bdag ni sogs bshags pa dang / bla ma rdor sems bstims nas dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag rdo rje sems dpa' 'grub gyur sogs brjod/ de nas slob dpon nam byang 'dren pa sogs kyis bskul la/

dpal ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma sogs dang / thos pa rgya mtsho ma tshar gsum/ chos rnams ma dang / khyod la bstod cing sogs 'dod gsol bya/ de nas slob ma rnams kyis maṇ+ḍal bdun ma 'bul ring / bla mas dkar gtor zlum po chab kyis bran pa la bya khyung gi phyag rgya dang / oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hriḥgasum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ oṃ mahā bhū ta a kar sogs phyag rgya dang bcas pas gtor mgron bkug oṃ in+d+ra sogs gtor sngags lan gsum mam lngas phyag rgya dang bcas gtor ma phul/ yid las sprul ba'i phyi nang gis mchod la/ chos bdag chen po 'khor bcas rnams/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma sogs nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog gi bar brjod la mtheb srin gyi se gol dang bcas/ muḥzhes brjod pas gtor mgron gshegs gsol byas la dge ba bsngo/ de nas slob dpon gyis sems bskyed gsal btab la/ lung dang dmigs khrid kyi thun ston pa la 'jug par bya'o/ /'dir smras pa/ zab yangs rgyud sde mang po'i dgongs pa'i bcud/ /grub pa'i slob dpon brgyad kyis bkral ba'i srol/ /sa skya'i yab chos lam skor phyi ma brgyad/ /'di 'dra thos shing spel pa skal ba bzang / /sprul pa'i skyes mchog sngags 'chang chos kyi rje/ /ngag gi dbang po kun dga' rin chen gyi/ /gsung rab 'phro can gang gi phrin las rgyun/ /spel phyir kha skong lhag bsam dag pas sbyar/ /'di sbyar dge bas bdag cag dpon slob rnams/ /tshe mthar phyin cing bsam don kun grub ste/ /dpal ldan sa skya'i chos srid dpal 'byor rnams/ /yar ngo'i zla ltar 'phel zhing rgyas gyur cig bdag la bstan la phan pa'i rigs brgyud 'ga'/ /myur du 'byung zhing de dag brgyud bcas kyis/ /dpal ldan sa skya'i dpal 'byor phun tshogs dang / /yab chos 'di rnams lhan cig rgyas byed shog bdag dang bdag la yid gtad slob bu rnams/ /nam zhig tshe 'di'i snang ba nub ma thag

'bral med lhan gcig bde ba can skyes nas/ /sprul pas 'gro kun zhing der 'dren gyur cig /ces bod yul bstan pa'i mnga' bdag rje btsun sa skya pa'i yab chos lam skor phyi ma brgyad kyi khrid yig sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po'i gsung rtsom 'phro can gyi kha bskang ba don gnyis lhun grub phrin las rgyun mi chad pa'i dga' ston zhes bya ba 'di yang sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po'i thog ma'i sras mchog 'jam mgon grub pa'i dbang phyug bsod nams dbang po dang / de'i gcung sngags 'chang rgyal ba'i rgyal tshab yab rje sbas pa'i sangs rgyas rgyal sras grags pa'i mtshan can/ dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi spyi gzugs rje btsun mus pa chen po sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan/ sprul pa'i sku lo nas spyan snga rin po che kun dga' don grub/ mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang chos grags la sogs te yongs 'dzin chos bzhin du spyod pa du ma'i zhabs rdul spyi bos len pa dpal sa skya pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal pos mdzad pa'i lam skor phyi ma brgyad kyi khrid yig ngo mtshar can gsung rab 'phro can de nyid kyi kha skong dgos pa'i rigs rnams/ mkhas pa'i dbang po dkon mchog lhun grub kyi dngos kyi slob ma lung rigs smra ba mgon po rin chen gyis mdzad pa'i lam skor phyi ma'i khrid kyi zin bris nas kha bskangs te/ 'dzin byed ces pa me pho byi ba'i lo cho 'phrul zla ba'i dmar cha dga' ba dang po'i tshes la bod kyi rdo rje gdan dpal sa skya'i chos grwa chen po'i gzhi thog bla brang gi bla ma gong mas byin gyis brlabs pa'i gnas mchog tshoms dmar gyi chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa rin po che'i bzhugs khri pad+ma can gyi drung du legs par sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni gso ba rig pa dang / yi ge'i 'du byed la mkhas pa gdong dga' ba bsam pa don chen gyis bgyis so/

/'di sbyar dge dang dus gsum dge ba yis/ /bdag cag dpon slob sdig kun byang gyur nas/ /yid la re ba'i don kun lhun 'grub par/ /rtsa brgyud bla mas byin gyis brlabs gyur cig sarba maṅga laṃ/ mastu sarba dza ga taṃ// //lam skor phyi ma brgyad kyi khrid dang byin rlabs kyi brgyud pa la tog rtse pa'i bsam mi khyab kyi man ngag gi brgyud pa ni rdo rje 'chang / rta mchog mda' 'dzin bī na ya/ pi wang 'dzin/ /rgyal po in+d+ra bhū ti/ phun tshogs zhabs/ grub chen sgeg pa'i rdo rje/ grub chen dha ri pa/ pad+ma badz+ra/ chos skyi ba/ bzang po'i zhabs/ 'byor 'dzin tog rtse pa/ bhū ṭha ṇa/ dha ma pa/ grub thob kah+ṇa pa/ dpa' bo rdo rje/ 'brog mi/ se ston/ zhang dgon pa ba/ sa chen/ bsod rtse/ rje btsun/ sa paṇa/ 'phags pa/ zhang dkon mchog dpal/ na bza' brag phug pa/ gong rung bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ bla ma dpal tshul ba/ grub chen bud+dha shrī/ ngor chen kun bzang / mus chen dkon rgyal/ zhwa lu ba chos rje sangs rgyas dpal bzang / mus chen nam mkha' dpal bzang / rje dkon mchog lhun grub/ rje nam mkha' dpal bzang / rtse gdong bdag chen kun dga' bsod nams lhun grub/ bla ma nam mkha' chos dar/ spyan snga kun dga' don 'grub kyi bar du byon pa la bdag sa skya pa ā nan+das zhus pa brgyud pa lugs gcig dang / yang mkhas pa'i dbang po ngor chen dkon mchog lhun grub kyis/ rjes mus chen dkon mchog rgya mtsho/ mkhan chen dbang phyug dpal bzang / rje thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang chos grags/ des bdag sa skya pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams la'o/ /yang na she'u lo tsā ba/ bla ma nam mkha' chos dar gyis gsan nam snyam ste cung zad brtag go /lo nas spyan snga rin po che kun dga' don grub/ des bdag sa skya pa ā nan+da la'o/ /yang na ngor chen kun bzang / mkhas mchog kun blo/

mkhas btsun dpal ldan rgyal po/ rje nam mkha'i mtshan can/ rje dkon mchog lhun grub man 'dra/ bsam mi khyab kyi byin rlabs kyi brgyud pa ni/ sa skya paṇa chen/ 'od shāka la ru ba ye shes mgon/ bag ston/ gzhon tshul/ tshul rgyal ba/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims pa man gong dang 'dra ba las/ rtse gdong bdag chen khri rin po che'i drung du sa skya pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis thos/ phyag rgya chen po yi ge med pa'i byin rlabs dang gdam ngag gi brgyud pa ni/ rje btsun ma sgron ma/ slob dpon ngag gi dbang phyug grags pa/ de wa a ka ra tsaṇ+ḍa/ de gnyis ka la jo bo a mo gha badz+ra gyis gsan/ de la 'brog mis gsan/ bla ma se mkhar chung pa man gong dang 'dra ba las byin rlabs rtse gdong nas khri'i drung dang / khrid lo nas spyan snga rin po che dang / mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa gnyis ka'i drung du sa skya pa ā nan+das thos/ mchod rten drung thob kyi brgyud pa ni rdo rje 'chang / phyag na rdo rje/ sa ra ha/ 'phags pa klu sgrub/ ār+ya de wa/ dge slong nag po zhabs/ zla ba grags pa/ bram ze dpal 'dzin/ ma he'i dbu can dpa' bo rdo rje/ 'brog mi man gong dang 'dra/ gtum mo lam rdzogs kyi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ slob dpon dril bu pa/ rus sbal zhabs/ dza lan+dha ra pa/ nag po spyod pa ro la zhon pa/ shrī dha ra/ ga ya dha ra/ 'brog mi man 'dra'o/ /yon po srong ba'i brgyud pa'ang de dang 'dra'o/ /in+d+ra bhu ti'i lam gyi brgyud pa ni/ dang po in+d+ra bhū ti che ba dpal ldan rdo rje'i zhal snga nas/ /de bzhin du yang drang srong gzugs/tshangs pa 'i zhabs dang / /rnal 'byor ma bram ze mo ni rdo rje grub/ /de nas shrī badz+ra bar pa bo dhi rgyal/ /de yis slob dpon de yi phyi ma u pa ma'i zhabs dang / /gos bral gcer bu pa zhal snga de bzhin no/

/dpal ldan dzñā na bar pa bo dhi rgyal/ /de bzhin shrī ya bo dhi dang / /slob dpon pad+ma badz+ra dang / /ḍom+bhi he ru ka'i zhal snga de bzhin no/ /yan lag bar ma dpal ldan mo/ /mkha' 'gro ma bung ba'i pad+ma de bzhin no/ /dur khrod du na ki lar bzhugs/ /lha lcam legs smin de bzhin no/ /bdag kyang dang po grub pa yin/ /zhes pa ltar rdo rje 'chang / dpal bde ba chen po/ in+d+ra bhū ti/ dpal tshangs pa'i zhabs/ bram ze mo/ grub pa'i rdo rje/ rgyal po in+d+ra bhū ti bar pa/ slob dpon dbu ma pa'i zhabs/ slob dpon gos bral zhabs/ rgyal po dzñā na bo dhi/ slob dpon pad+ma badz+ra/ ḍom+bhi he ru ka yan lag bar ma'i zhabs/ lha mo bung ba'i pad+ma/ lcam legs smin/ rgyal po in+d+ra bhū ti chung ba/ de'i slob ma bram ze rin chen rdo rje/ de la kha che shes rab gsang bas gsan/ de la 'brog mis te/ de man 'dra'o/ /nye brgyud ni rdo rje dang / in+d+ra bhū ti che ba/ lcam legs smin/ shes rab gsang ba/ 'brog mi man chad gong bzhin no/ /pad+ma badz+ra'i lam gyi brgyud pa ni/ bi la pe grub thob chos 'chad kyi phyag rgya badz+ra/ yan lag med pa'i rdo rje/ mtsho skyes rdo rje/ in+d+ra bhū ti/ lcam legs smin/ nag po spyod pa/ bram ze dpal 'dzin/ rje ga ya dha ra/ 'brog mi man 'dra'o/ /ḍom+bhi ba'i lhan cig skyes grub kyi brgyud ba ni rdo rje 'chang / ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ ḍom+bhi pa/ a la la badz+ra/ nags khrod pa/ gar+bha ri pa/ bsod snyoms pa/ mi thub zla ba/ dpa' bo rdo rje/ 'brog mi man sngar dang 'dra'o// //sarba maṅga laṃ// // ༈ mkhan chen a pad rin po che'i dgongs bzhed ltar gu rus zhabs zhu bgyis pa'o// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 a myes zhabs/ rje btsun sa skya pa'i yab chos lam skor phyi ma brgyad kyi khrid yig PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
